      else addPlayers(pickLeave(d),-1);
    }
    if(Math.random()<.06)addPlayers(pickJoin(d),3+Math.floor(Math.random()*6));
  }

  /* ───────── 配色：人数 浅橙红 → 深红 ───────── */
  var STOPS=[[255,176,128],[255,112,64],[228,52,38],[150,10,30]],maxCount=1,haloCache={};
  function heatT(t){var p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t))*3,i=Math.min(2,Math.floor(p)),f=p-i,a=STOPS[i],b=STOPS[i+1];return [0,1,2].map(function(j){return Math.round(a[j]+(b[j]-a[j])*f);});}
  function rgba(c,a){return 'rgba('+c[0]+','+c[1]+','+c[2]+','+a+')';}
  function glowSprite(c,size,core){var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=size;var g=cv.getContext('2d'),h=size/2,gr=g.createRadialGradient(h,h,0,h,h,h);gr.addColorStop(0,rgba(core||c,1));gr.addColorStop(.2,rgba(c,.8));gr.addColorStop(.5,rgba(c,.24));gr.addColorStop(1,rgba(c,0));g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,size,size);return cv;}
  function haloFor(step){return haloCache[step]||(haloCache[step]=glowSprite(heatT(step/23),64,[255,236,224]));}
  var active=[];
  function recalc(){
    maxCount=1;active=[];
    countries.forEach(function(c){if(c.count>0){active.push(c);if(c.count>maxCount)maxCount=c.count;}});
    countries.forEach(function(c){var t=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,c.count)/maxCount);c.step=Math.round(t*23);c.rgb=heatT(t);c.radT=2.6+5.4*t;});
  }
  function parseCol(s,fb){s=(s||'').trim();var m=/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(s);if(m){var h=m[1];if(h.length===3)h=h.replace(/./g,'$&$&');return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16),parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16),parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)];}m=/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/i.exec(s);if(m){var p=m[1].split(/[\s,\/]+/).map(parseFloat);if(p.length>=3&&!isNaN(p[0]))return [p[0],p[1],p[2]];}return fb;}
  function mix(a,b,t){return [0,1,2].map(function(i){return Math.round(a[i]+(b[i]-a[i])*t);});}
  var theme={key:'',acc:[59,130,246],light:false,sprite:null};
  function readTheme(){
    var acc=parseCol(getComputedStyle(page).getPropertyValue('--accent'),[59,130,246]),light=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')==='light',key=acc.join(',')+'|'+light;
    if(key===theme.key)return;theme.key=key;theme.acc=acc;theme.light=light;
    theme.sprite=glowSprite(acc,32,light?acc:mix(acc,[255,255,255],.6));
  }

  /* ───────── 粒子：斐波那契球面均匀采样，陆地(含海岸加亮)沿真实经纬度保留，海洋仅留稀疏暗点 ───────── */
  var N=15000,GA=Math.PI*(3-Math.sqrt(5)),PX=[],PY=[],PZ=[],PK=[],PS=[];
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
    var y=1-2*(i+.5)/N,rr=Math.sqrt(1-y*y),th=GA*i,x=Math.cos(th)*rr,z=Math.sin(th)*rr;
    var lat=Math.asin(y)*180/Math.PI,lon=Math.atan2(x,z)*180/Math.PI;
    var mi=Math.min(MW-1,Math.floor((lon+180)/360*MW)),mj=Math.min(MH-1,Math.floor((90-lat)/180*MH));
    var land=mask[mj*MW+mi],kind;
    if(land){kind=(!landAt(mi+2,mj)||!landAt(mi-2,mj)||!landAt(mi,mj+2)||!landAt(mi,mj-2))?2:1;}
    else{if(Math.random()>.2)continue;kind=0;}
    PX.push(x);PY.push(y);PZ.push(z);PK.push(kind);PS.push(Math.random()*6.283);
  }
  var PN=PX.length;

  /* ───────── 状态 ───────── */
  var canvas=document.getElementById('worldGlobeCanvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),list=document.getElementById('worldCountryList'),tip=document.getElementById('worldCountryTip'),stage=canvas.parentElement,totalEl=document.getElementById('worldTotal');
  var W=900,H=560,rot=-1.2,tilt=.28,vel=0,dragging=false,lastX=0,lastY=0,downX=0,downY=0,moved=0,hoverIndex=-1,raf=0,frame=0,focus=null,touched=false,tot=S,langSeen=uiState.lang,timer=0,lastTick=Date.now(),listHover=false,lastSort=0;
  function geom(){var r=Math.min(W,H)*.42;return {r:r,cx:W/2,cy:H/2,sc:Math.max(.7,Math.min(1.45,r/300))};}
  function proj(v,g){var cr=Math.cos(rot),sr=Math.sin(rot),ct=Math.cos(tilt),st=Math.sin(tilt),x=v.x*cr+v.z*sr,z0=v.z*cr-v.x*sr,y=v.y*ct-z0*st,z=v.y*st+z0*ct;return {x:g.cx+x*g.r,y:g.cy-y*g.r,z:z};}
  function resize(){var dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();W=Math.max(300,rect.width);H=Math.max(300,rect.height);canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);}
  function cname(c){var k='cn_'+c.code,tb=UI_T[uiState.lang],v=(tb&&tb[k])||UI_T.en[k];if(v)return v;if(c.dyn){var r=regionName(c.code);if(r)return r;}return c.name;}

  /* ───────── 绘制 ───────── */
  function draw(now){
    if(!page.classList.contains('open')){raf=0;return;}
    if(uiState.lang!==langSeen){langSeen=uiState.lang;relabel();}
    if(frame++%45===0)readTheme();
    var t=now/1000,g=geom(),cx=g.cx,cy=g.cy,R=g.r,sc=g.sc,light=theme.light,acc=theme.acc;
    if(!dragging){
      if(focus){var dr=focus.rot-rot,dt=focus.tilt-tilt;rot+=dr*.09;tilt+=dt*.09;vel=0;if(Math.abs(dr)<.002&&Math.abs(dt)<.002)focus=null;}
      else if(Math.abs(vel)>.0003){rot+=vel;vel*=.94;}
      else if(hoverIndex<0&&autoRot)rot+=.0018;
    }
    if(Math.abs(tot-S)>.01){tot+=(S-tot)*.16;if(Math.abs(tot-S)<.5)tot=S;var s=fmt(Math.round(tot));if(totalEl.textContent!==s)totalEl.textContent=s;}
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    var base=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx-R*.3,cy-R*.35,R*.1,cx,cy,R);
    base.addColorStop(0,rgba(acc,light?.10:.14));base.addColorStop(1,rgba(acc,light?.02:.03));
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,6.2832);ctx.fillStyle=base;ctx.fill();
    var atm=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,R*.97,cx,cy,R*1.24);
    atm.addColorStop(0,rgba(acc,light?.22:.34));atm.addColorStop(.35,rgba(acc,light?.07:.12));atm.addColorStop(1,rgba(acc,0));
    ctx.fillStyle=atm;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*1.24,0,6.2832);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle=rgba(acc,light?.35:.28);ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation=light?'source-over':'lighter';
    var cr=Math.cos(rot),sr=Math.sin(rot),ct=Math.cos(tilt),st=Math.sin(tilt),spr=theme.sprite;
    for(var i=0;i<PN;i++){
      var X=PX[i],Y=PY[i],Z=PZ[i],x=X*cr+Z*sr,z0=Z*cr-X*sr,yy=Y*ct-z0*st,z=Y*st+z0*ct,k=PK[i],d,a;
      if(z<0){if(k===0||light)continue;a=.07;d=2.4*sc;}
      else{
        var tw=1+.2*Math.sin(t*2.1+PS[i]);
        if(k===0){a=.10+.18*z;d=2.2*sc*tw;}
        else if(k===1){a=.30+.70*z;d=(3.3+1.5*z)*sc*tw;}
        else{a=.55+.45*z;d=(4.6+1.8*z)*sc*tw;}
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.drawImage(spr,cx+x*R-d/2,cy-yy*R-d/2,d,d);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    var vis=[],shp=[];
    for(var j=0;j<countries.length;j++){
      var c=countries[j];c.ap+=((c.count>0?1:0)-c.ap)*.12;c.dr+=((c.radT||3)-c.dr)*.12;
      if(c.ap<.03)continue;
      if(c.sh){shp.push(c);continue;}
      var q=proj(c.v,g);if(q.z>.02){q.c=c;vis.push(q);}
    }
    /* 国家板块：按真实轮廓填色（人数越多颜色越深/越亮），背面顶点压到球体边缘，面积大的先画、小国压在上面 */
    shp.sort(function(a,b){return b.sh.area-a.sh.area;});
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.lineJoin='round';
    shp.forEach(function(c){
      var path=new Path2D(),zb=-2,ri,r,k,m,X,Y,Z,x,z0,yy,z,l,first;
      for(ri=0;ri<c.sh.rings.length;ri++){
        r=c.sh.rings[ri];z0=r.cz*cr-r.cx*sr;z=r.cy*st+z0*ct;
        if(z<-Math.sin(Math.min(r.ang,1.5708)))continue;
        if(z>zb)zb=z;
        var v=r.v;m=v.length;first=true;var rp=new Path2D();
        for(k=0;k<m;k+=3){
          X=v[k];Y=v[k+1];Z=v[k+2];x=X*cr+Z*sr;z0=Z*cr-X*sr;yy=Y*ct-z0*st;z=Y*st+z0*ct;
          if(z<0){l=Math.sqrt(x*x+yy*yy)||1;x/=l;yy/=l;}
          if(first){rp.moveTo(cx+x*R,cy-yy*R);first=false;}else rp.lineTo(cx+x*R,cy-yy*R);
        }
        rp.closePath();path.addPath(rp);
      }
      if(zb<-1)return;
      var hov=c.i===hoverIndex,fade=Math.min(1,(zb+.12)/.4)*c.ap*dimOf(c),tn=c.step/23,pu=.92+.08*Math.sin(t*2.2+c.ph);
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,fade)*Math.min(1,(.34+.5*tn)*pu+(hov?.22:0))*(light?.9:1);
      ctx.fillStyle=rgba(c.rgb,1);ctx.fill(path,'evenodd');
      var fa=(now-c.flash)/1400;
      if(fa>=0&&fa<1){ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,fade)*(1-fa)*.6;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,236,224,1)';ctx.fill(path,'evenodd');}
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,fade);
      if(hov){ctx.shadowColor=rgba(c.rgb,.95);ctx.shadowBlur=16;}
      ctx.lineWidth=hov?2:(light?.9:.8);ctx.strokeStyle=hov?'#fff':(light?'rgba(60,40,30,.55)':'rgba(255,236,224,.55)');ctx.stroke(path);
      ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.shadowColor='transparent';
      if(c===me){var mp=(t*.9)%1;ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.95)';ctx.stroke(path);
        ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,fade)*(1-mp)*.8;ctx.lineWidth=1.4+mp*5;ctx.strokeStyle=rgba(acc,1);ctx.stroke(path);}
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    vis.sort(function(a,b){return a.z-b.z;});
    vis.forEach(function(q){
      var c=q.c,hov=c.i===hoverIndex,fade=Math.min(1,q.z/.3)*c.ap*dimOf(c),rd=c.dr*sc*(hov?1.25:1),pu=.88+.12*Math.sin(t*2.4+c.ph),hs=rd*(hov?9:6.4)*pu;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation=light?'source-over':'lighter';
      ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(light?.55:.9);ctx.drawImage(haloFor(c.step),q.x-hs/2,q.y-hs/2,hs,hs);
      var p=((t*.55+c.ph/6.283)%1);
      ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(1-p)*.55;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd+p*rd*2.8,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle=rgba(c.rgb,1);ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.stroke();
      var fa=(now-c.flash)/1400;
      if(fa>=0&&fa<1){ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(1-fa)*.9;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd+fa*rd*4.6,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,236,224,1)';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.stroke();}
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
      ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd*.62,0,6.2832);ctx.fillStyle=rgba(c.rgb,1);ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,236,224,'+(hov?.95:.55)+')';ctx.stroke();
      if(c===me){var mp=(t*.9)%1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd+5,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.9)';ctx.lineWidth=1.4;ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(1-mp)*.7;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd+5+mp*rd*3.4,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle=rgba(acc,1);ctx.lineWidth=1.4;ctx.stroke();}
      if(hov){ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,rd+3.5,0,6.2832);ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.stroke();}
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    if(hoverIndex>=0&&!tip.hidden){var hq=proj(countries[hoverIndex].v,g);if(hq.z<=.02){tip.hidden=true;}else positionTip(hoverIndex);}
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  /* ───────── 列表 / 悬浮提示 ───────── */
  var rows=[];
  function buildRow(c){
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='world-country-row';row.dataset.index=c.i;row.tabIndex=0;
    row.innerHTML='<img class="world-flag" alt="" src="https://flagcdn.com/w40/'+c.code+'.png" loading="lazy"><span class="world-country-name"><b class="wn"></b><small class="ws"></small></span><span class="world-country-count"><i class="wc"></i><small class="wp"></small></span>';
    row._n=row.querySelector('.wn');row._s=row.querySelector('.ws');row._c=row.querySelector('.wc');row._p=row.querySelector('.wp');row._last=-1;
    row.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){selectCountry(c.i,true);});
    row.addEventListener('focus',function(){selectCountry(c.i,true);});
    row.addEventListener('click',function(){touched=true;focusCountry(c.i);});
    rows[c.i]=row;list.appendChild(row);fillRow(c,true);return row;
  }
  function youBadge(){return '<em class="world-you">'+esc(T('worldYou'))+'</em>';}
  function fillRow(c,full){
    var row=rows[c.i];if(!row)return;
    if(full){row._n.innerHTML=esc(cname(c))+(c===me?youBadge():'');row._s.textContent=c===me?T('worldYouHere'):T('worldRegion');row._p.textContent=T('worldPlayers');}
    if(row._last!==c.count){
      var up=row._last>=0&&c.count>row._last,dn=row._last>=0&&c.count<row._last;row._last=c.count;row._c.textContent=fmt(c.count);
      row.style.display=(c.count>0&&rowMatch(c))?'':'none';
      if(up||dn){row._c.classList.remove('up','dn');void row._c.offsetWidth;row._c.classList.add(up?'up':'dn');}
    }
  }
  function sortRows(force){
    var nowMs=Date.now();if(!force&&(listHover||nowMs-lastSort<5000))return;lastSort=nowMs;
    active.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.count-a.count;}).forEach(function(c){list.appendChild(rows[c.i]);});
  }
  function renderList(){countries.forEach(buildRow);sortRows(true);list.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){listHover=true;});list.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){listHover=false;clearHover();});}
  function tipHtml(c){return '<div class="world-tip-title"><img alt="" src="https://flagcdn.com/w40/'+c.code+'.png"><strong>'+esc(cname(c))+'</strong>'+(c===me?youBadge():'')+'</div><b><i class="wtn">'+esc(fmt(c.count))+'</i><small>'+esc(T('worldOnline'))+'</small></b>';}
  function positionTip(i){
    var c=countries[i],g=geom(),rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),q=proj(c.v,g),stageRect=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),
        ax=rect.left-stageRect.left+q.x,ay=rect.top-stageRect.top+q.y,
        left=Math.max(8,Math.min(stageRect.width-tip.offsetWidth-8,ax+16)),top=Math.max(8,Math.min(stageRect.height-tip.offsetHeight-8,ay-tip.offsetHeight/2));
    tip.style.left=left+'px';tip.style.top=top+'px';tip.classList.toggle('tip-left',left<ax-tip.offsetWidth);
    tip.style.setProperty('--tip-arrow-y',Math.max(12,Math.min(tip.offsetHeight-12,ay-top))+'px');
  }
  function selectCountry(i,showTip){
    hoverIndex=i;
    list.querySelectorAll('.world-country-row.active').forEach(function(n){n.classList.remove('active');});
    if(rows[i])rows[i].classList.add('active');
    if(showTip){var c=countries[i];tip.hidden=false;tip.innerHTML=tipHtml(c);
      var q=proj(c.v,geom());if(q.z<=.02){tip.hidden=true;return;}positionTip(i);}
  }
  function clearHover(){hoverIndex=-1;tip.hidden=true;list.querySelectorAll('.world-country-row.active').forEach(function(n){n.classList.remove('active');});}
  function focusOn(c,ratio){var tr=-c.lon*Math.PI/180,d=((tr-rot+Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI)+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI)-Math.PI;focus={rot:rot+d,tilt:Math.max(-.8,Math.min(.8,c.lat*Math.PI/180*(ratio||.85)))};}
  function focusCountry(i){var c=countries[i];selectCountry(i,false);focusOn(c);tip.hidden=false;tip.innerHTML=tipHtml(c);showDetail(c);}
  /* 屏幕坐标 → 经纬度（orthographic 反算）；再用真实轮廓做点在多边形内判断（偶奇规则，含内湖/飞地孔） */
  function invPick(x,y,g){
    var sx=(x-g.cx)/g.r,sy=(g.cy-y)/g.r,d=sx*sx+sy*sy;if(d>=1)return null;
    var z=Math.sqrt(1-d),cr=Math.cos(rot),sr=Math.sin(rot),ct=Math.cos(tilt),st=Math.sin(tilt),vy=sy*ct+z*st,z0=z*ct-sy*st,vx=sx*cr-z0*sr,vz=z0*cr+sx*sr;
    return {lat:Math.asin(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,vy)))*180/Math.PI,lon:Math.atan2(vx,vz)*180/Math.PI};
  }
  function inShape(c,lon,lat){
    var ins=false,ri,r,k,j,n,xi,yi,xj,yj,hit;
    for(ri=0;ri<c.sh.rings.length;ri++){
      r=c.sh.rings[ri];if(lon<r.x0||lon>r.x1||lat<r.y0||lat>r.y1)continue;
      n=r.lo.length;hit=false;
      for(k=0,j=n-1;k<n;j=k++){xi=r.lo[k];yi=r.la[k];xj=r.lo[j];yj=r.la[j];
        if(((yi>lat)!==(yj>lat))&&(lon<(xj-xi)*(lat-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi))hit=!hit;}
      if(hit)ins=!ins;
    }
    return ins;
  }
  function findCountryAt(clientX,clientY){
    var rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),x=clientX-rect.left,y=clientY-rect.top,g=geom(),best=1e9,idx=-1;
    var offs=[[0,0],[2,0],[-2,0],[0,2],[0,-2],[3,3],[-3,3],[3,-3],[-3,-3]],o,p,k;
    for(o=0;o<offs.length;o++){            /* 国界只有 1px 缝隙，周围取几个点避免悬停闪烁 */
      p=invPick(x+offs[o][0],y+offs[o][1],g);if(!p)continue;
      for(k=0;k<active.length;k++){var ac=active[k];if(ac.sh&&inShape(ac,p.lon,p.lat))return ac.i;}
    }
    active.forEach(function(c){if(c.sh)return;var q=proj(c.v,g);if(q.z<=.02)return;var lim=Math.max(13,c.dr*g.sc+7),d=Math.hypot(q.x-x,q.y-y);if(d<lim&&d<best){best=d;idx=c.i;}});
    return idx;
  }
  function findCountryAtOld(clientX,clientY){
    var rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),x=clientX-rect.left,y=clientY-rect.top,g=geom(),best=1e9,idx=-1;
    active.forEach(function(c){var q=proj(c.v,g);if(q.z<=.02)return;var lim=Math.max(13,c.dr*g.sc+7),d=Math.hypot(q.x-x,q.y-y);if(d<lim&&d<best){best=d;idx=c.i;}});
    return idx;
  }
  /* 整页文案：data-ui 节点 + 标题/无障碍标签 + 列表 + 提示 */
  function relabel(){
    page.querySelectorAll('[data-ui]').forEach(function(n){n.textContent=T(n.getAttribute('data-ui'));});
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label',T('worldAria'));openBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',T('worldBtnTitle'));openBtn.title=T('worldBtnTitle');
    countries.forEach(function(c){fillRow(c,true);});
    if(hoverIndex>=0&&!tip.hidden)tip.innerHTML=tipHtml(countries[hoverIndex]);
    totalEl.textContent=fmt(Math.round(tot));
    labelTools();
  }
  function refreshLive(){
    recalc();
    countries.forEach(function(c){fillRow(c,false);});
    sortRows(false);
    if(hoverIndex>=0&&!tip.hidden){var n=tip.querySelector('.wtn');if(n)n.textContent=fmt(countries[hoverIndex].count);}
    if(detailC)drawDetail(false);
  }


  /* ───────── 国家列表搜索 / 地区筛选 / 点击国家的 24h 趋势 / 自动旋转开关 ───────── */
  var AUTO_KEY='starline.world.auto',autoRot=true,regionSel='',qSel='',detailC=null;
  try{autoRot=localStorage.getItem(AUTO_KEY)!=='0';}catch(e){}
  var REGN={"United States":"Americas","Canada":"Americas","Mexico":"Americas","Guatemala":"Americas","Cuba":"Americas","Panama":"Americas","Costa Rica":"Americas","Jamaica":"Americas","Haiti":"Americas","Dominican Republic":"Americas","Colombia":"Americas","Venezuela":"Americas","Ecuador":"Americas","Peru":"Americas","Bolivia":"Americas","Chile":"Americas","Argentina":"Americas","Uruguay":"Americas","Paraguay":"Americas","Brazil":"Americas","Bahamas":"Americas","Belize":"Americas","Honduras":"Americas","El   var REGC={Americas:[12,-80],Europe:[50,15],Asia:[34,95],Africa:[5,20],Oceania:[-22,140]};
  var REGK=[['','worldAll'],['Americas','worldRegAmericas'],['Europe','worldRegEurope'],['Asia','worldRegAsia'],['Africa','worldRegAfrica'],['Oceania','worldRegOceania']];
  function rgOf(c){
    if(c.rg===undefined){
      c.rg=REGN[c.name]||'';
      if(!c.rg){var la=c.lat,lo=c.lon;
        c.rg=(lo<-30)?'Americas':(lo<45&&la>=35)?'Europe':(lo<55&&la<35&&lo>-25)?'Africa':(lo>=110&&la<-10)||lo>150?'Oceania':'Asia';}
    }
    return c.rg;
  }
  function dimOf(c){return regionSel&&rgOf(c)!==regionSel?.22:1;}
  function rowMatch(c){
    if(regionSel&&rgOf(c)!==regionSel)return false;
    if(qSel){var n=(cname(c)+' '+c.name+' '+c.code).toLowerCase();if(n.indexOf(qSel)<0)return false;}
    return true;
  }
  function applyListFilter(){
    var vis=0;
    countries.forEach(function(c){var r=rows[c.i];if(!r)return;var ok=c.count>0&&rowMatch(c);r.style.display=ok?'':'none';if(ok)vis++;});
    var nm=document.getElementById('worldNoMatch');if(nm)nm.hidden=vis>0||!(qSel||regionSel);
  }
  function labelTools(){
    var sq=document.getElementById('worldSearch');if(sq)sq.placeholder=T('worldSearchPh');
    var rg=document.getElementById('worldRegions');
    if(rg)Array.prototype.forEach.call(rg.children,function(b){b.textContent=T(b.getAttribute('data-k'));});
    var d=document.getElementById('worldDetail');
    if(d&&detailC&&!d.hidden){buildDetail(detailC);}
  }
  function initTools(){
    var rg=document.getElementById('worldRegions'),sq=document.getElementById('worldSearch'),ab=document.getElementById('worldAutoBtn');
    if(rg&&!rg._b){
      rg._b=1;
      REGK.forEach(function(p){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='world-chip'+(p[0]===''?' on':'');b.setAttribute('data-r',p[0]);b.setAttribute('data-k',p[1]);rg.appendChild(b);});
      rg.addEventListener('click',function(e){
        var b=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.world-chip'):null;if(!b)return;
        var r=b.getAttribute('data-r');regionSel=(regionSel===r)?'':r;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(rg.children,function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x.getAttribute('data-r')===regionSel);});
        applyListFilter();
        if(regionSel){var cc=REGC[regionSel];touched=true;focusOn({lon:cc[1],lat:cc[0]},.7);}
      });
    }
    if(sq&&!sq._b){
      sq._b=1;
      sq.addEventListener('input',function(){qSel=sq.value.trim().toLowerCase();applyListFilter();});
      sq.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
        if(e.key==='Enter'){
          var first=null;for(var k=0;k<list.children.length;k++){var r=list.children[k];if(r.style.display!=='none'){first=r;break;}}
          if(first)first.click();
        }else if(e.key==='Escape'&&sq.value){e.stopPropagation();e.preventDefault();sq.value='';qSel='';applyListFilter();}
      });
    }
    if(ab&&!ab._b){
      ab._b=1;ab.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(autoRot));
      ab.addEventListener('click',function(){autoRot=!autoRot;ab.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(autoRot));try{localStorage.setItem(AUTO_KEY,autoRot?'1':'0');}catch(e){}});
    }
  }
  /* 24h 趋势：与列表同一套昼夜模型（DAY × 经度时差）按小时回推，叠加按国家+小时固定的 ±6% 抖动；最后一点就是当前实时人数 */
  function dayS(c,ms){var d=new Date(ms),h=(d.getUTCHours()+d.getUTCMinutes()/60+c.lon/15+48)%24,i=Math.floor(h),f=h-i;return DAY[i]*(1-f)+DAY[(i+1)%24]*f;}
  function hash01(s){var x=2166136261,i;for(i=0;i<s.length;i++){x^=s.charCodeAt(i);x=Math.imul(x,16777619)>>>0;}x^=x>>>15;x=Math.imul(x,2246822519)>>>0;x^=x>>>13;return (x%1000)/1000;}
  function trendSeries(c){
    var out=[],now=Date.now(),cur=dayS(c,now)||1,k,t,v;
    for(k=24;k>=0;k--){
      t=now-k*3600000;
      v=k===0?c.count:Math.max(0,Math.round(c.count*dayS(c,t)/cur*(1+(hash01(c.code+'|'+Math.floor(t/3600000))-.5)*.12)));
      out.push(v);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function buildDetail(c){
    var d=document.getElementById('worldDetail');if(!d)return;
    d.innerHTML='<div class="wd-head"><img alt="" src="https://flagcdn.com/w40/'+c.code+'.png"><strong class="wd-name"></strong><button type="button" class="wd-x" aria-label="'+esc(T('worldCloseDetail'))+'">×</button></div>'
      +'<div class="wd-now"><b class="wd-n">0</b><small>'+esc(T('worldOnline'))+'</small></div>'
      +'<svg class="wd-svg" viewBox="0 0 288 76" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path class="wd-area"/><path class="wd-line"/><circle class="wd-dot" r="3"/></svg>'
      +'<div class="wd-axis"><span>-24h</span><span>-12h</span><span>'+esc(T('worldNowL'))+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="wd-stats"><span><small>'+esc(T('worldPeak'))+'</small><b class="wd-pk">0</b></span><span><small>'+esc(T('worldLow'))+'</small><b class="wd-lo">0</b></span><span><small>'+esc(T('worldNowL'))+'</small><b class="wd-cu">0</b></span></div>'
      +'<div class="wd-cap">'+esc(T('worldTrend'))+'</div>';
    d.querySelector('.wd-x').addEventListener('click',function(){detailC=null;d.hidden=true;});
    d.hidden=false;drawDetail(true);
  }
  function showDetail(c){detailC=c;buildDetail(c);}
  function drawDetail(full){
    var c=detailC,d=document.getElementById('worldDetail');if(!c||!d||d.hidden)return;
    var s=trendSeries(c),mx=Math.max.apply(null,s),mn=Math.min.apply(null,s),W=288,H=76,p=5,rg=Math.max(1,mx-mn),pts=s.map(function(v,i){return [p+i*(W-2*p)/24,H-p-(v-mn)/rg*(H-2*p)];});
    var line=pts.map(function(q,i){return (i?'L':'M')+q[0].toFixed(1)+' '+q[1].toFixed(1);}).join('');
    var set=function(sel,fn){var n=d.querySelector(sel);if(n)fn(n);};
    set('.wd-name',function(n){n.textContent=cname(c)+(c===me?'  ·  '+T('worldYou'):'');});
    set('.wd-n',function(n){n.textContent=fmt(c.count);});
    set('.wd-line',function(n){n.setAttribute('d',line);});
    set('.wd-area',function(n){n.setAttribute('d',line+'L'+pts[24][0].toFixed(1)+' '+H+'L'+pts[0][0].toFixed(1)+' '+H+'Z');});
    set('.wd-dot',function(n){n.setAttribute('cx',pts[24][0].toFixed(1));n.setAttribute('cy',pts[24][1].toFixed(1));});
    set('.wd-pk',function(n){n.textContent=fmt(mx);});set('.wd-lo',function(n){n.textContent=fmt(mn);});set('.wd-cu',function(n){n.textContent=fmt(c.count);});
  }

  /* ───────── 当前 IP → 国家（真实定位）；所在国人数不低于 5 ───────── */
  var GEO_KEY='starline.worldGeo.v1',geoStarted=false;
  function fetchJson(url,ms){return new Promise(function(res,rej){var ctl=window.AbortController?new AbortController():null,tm=setTimeout(function(){if(ctl)ctl.abort();rej(new Error('timeout'));},ms);fetch(url,{cache:'no-store',credentials:'omit',signal:ctl?ctl.signal:undefined}).then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw new Error('http');return r.json();}).then(function(d){clearTimeout(tm);res(d);},function(e){clearTimeout(tm);rej(e);});});}
  var GEO_SRC=[
    {u:'https://ipwho.is/',f:function(d){return d&&d.success!==false&&d.country_code?{code:d.country_code,name:d.country,lat:d.latitude,lon:d.longitude}:null;}},
    {u:'https://ipapi.co/json/',f:function(d){return d&&!d.error&&d.country_code?{code:d.country_code,name:d.country_name,lat:d.latitude,lon:d.longitude}:null;}},
    {u:'https://api.country.is/',f:function(d){return d&&d.country?{code:d.country}:null;}}
  ];
  function geoCached(){try{var o=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(GEO_KEY)||'null');if(o&&o.code&&Date.now()-o.t<3600000)return o;}catch(e){}return null;}
  function geoLookup(){
    return GEO_SRC.reduce(function(p,s){return p.then(function(r){if(r)return r;return fetchJson(s.u,5000).then(s.f).catch(function(){return null;});});},Promise.resolve(null)).then(function(r){
      if(r&&r.code){r.t=Date.now();try{localStorage.setItem(GEO_KEY,JSON.stringify(r));}catch(e){}return r;}
      var m=/[-_]([A-Za-z]{2})\b/.exec(navigator.language||'');return m?{code:m[1],locale:true}:null;   /* 全部网络源失败时，退回系统区域设置 */
    });
  }
  function setMe(info){
    if(!info||!info.code)return;var code=String(info.code).toLowerCase(),c=byCode[code];
    if(!c){if(typeof info.lat!=='number'||typeof info.lon!=='number')return;c=mkCountry(info.name||regionName(code)||code.toUpperCase(),codeToFlag(code),info.lat,info.lon,true);buildRow(c);}
    var prev=me;if(prev&&prev!==c){fillRow(prev,true);}
    me=c;
    if(c.count<MIN_ME){var need=MIN_ME-c.count;c.count+=need;S+=need;c.flash=performance.now();var guard=0;while(S>T1&&guard++<400){var o=pickLeave(new Date());if(!o||o===c)break;addPlayers(o,-1);}}
    recalc();countries.forEach(function(x){fillRow(x,x===c||x===prev);});sortRows(true);
    if(!touched&&page.classList.contains('open')){focusOn(c,.6);}
    else if(!touched){rot=-c.lon*Math.PI/180;tilt=Math.max(-.8,Math.min(.8,c.lat*Math.PI/180*.6));}
  }
  function startGeo(){
    if(geoStarted)return;geoStarted=true;
    var cached=geoCached();if(cached){setMe(cached);return;}
    geoLookup().then(setMe).catch(function(){});
  }

  /* ───────── 交互：指针拖动旋转 / 悬停 / 点击聚焦 ───────── */
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){dragging=true;touched=true;moved=0;downX=lastX=e.clientX;downY=lastY=e.clientY;vel=0;focus=null;try{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_){}});
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(dragging){var dx=e.clientX-lastX,dy=e.clientY-lastY;rot+=dx*.0065;vel=dx*.0065;tilt=Math.max(-.9,Math.min(.9,tilt+dy*.005));lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;moved=Math.max(moved,Math.hypot(e.clientX-downX,e.clientY-downY));if(moved>4){tip.hidden=true;}return;}
    var i=findCountryAt(e.clientX,e.clientY);
    if(i>=0){if(i!==hoverIndex||tip.hidden)selectCountry(i,true);canvas.style.cursor='pointer';}
    else{if(hoverIndex>=0)clearHover();canvas.style.cursor='';}
  });
  function endDrag(e){if(!dragging)return;dragging=false;if(moved<=4){var i=findCountryAt(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(i>=0)focusCountry(i);}}
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){dragging=false;});
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){if(!dragging)clearHover();});

  /* ───────── 开关页面 / 实时更新循环 ───────── */
  function schedule(){timer=setTimeout(function(){tick();lastTick=Date.now();refreshLive();if(page.classList.contains('open'))schedule();},700+Math.random()*1700);}
  function show(){
    page.classList.add('open');page.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
    readTheme();resize();relabel();
    var missed=Math.min(30,Math.floor((Date.now()-lastTick)/1800));for(var k=0;k<missed;k++)tick();lastTick=Date.now();refreshLive();tot=S;totalEl.textContent=fmt(S);
    startGeo();
    if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);if(!timer)schedule();
  }
  function hide(){page.classList.remove('open');page.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.body.style.overflow='';clearHover();dragging=false;if(raf){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}if(timer){clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;}}
  recalc();renderList();initTools();relabel();
  openBtn.addEventListener('click',show);
  var backBtn=document.getElementById('worldBackBtn');if(backBtn)backBtn.addEventListener('click',hide);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&page.classList.contains('open'))hide();});
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(page.classList.contains('open'))resize();});
  /* 语言切换 / 保存自定义翻译时刷新（uiSetLang 每次都会调用 ctRefreshLabels） */
  (function(){
    var p1=window.ctRefreshLabels;window.ctRefreshLabels=function(){var r;if(typeof p1==='function'){try{r=p1.apply(this,arguments);}catch(e){}}try{relabel();}catch(e){}return r;};
    if(typeof window.onUiLangChanged==='function'){var p2=window.onUiLangChanged;window.onUiLangChanged=function(){var r;try{r=p2.apply(this,arguments);}catch(e){}try{relabel();}catch(e){}return r;};}
  })();
})();

<script>
__UI_SCRIPT__


  var LICENSES = __LICENSES_JSON__;
  var ACTIVE_GAME = (LICENSES && LICENSES.active) || '';

  /* 游戏列表 & 顺序由宿主从 games.txt 注入 */
  var GAMES = __GAMES_JSON__;
  var ORDER = __GAMES_ORDER_JSON__;

  /* 精选 banner：只收录 games.txt 里 featured = true 的游戏，顺序沿用文件顺序；
     一个都没标（或标注的游戏不存在）时回退成全部游戏，避免 banner 空白。 */
  var HERO_ORDER = (function(){
    var picked = ORDER.filter(function(g){
      return !!(GAMES[g] && GAMES[g].featured);
    });
    return picked.length ? picked : ORDER.slice();
  })();
  var HERO_GAME = HERO_ORDER[0] || '';
  var HERO_POS = 0;
  var CURRENT_GAME = '';
  /* 暂停规则：
     · 点过「启动」并注入成功 = 本次运行期间不能再暂停
     · 暂停中 / 暂停请求处理中 = 不能点「启动」
     宿主也会用进程检测兜底，这里负责界面即时反馈。 */
  var LAUNCHED = {};        /* game -> true（本次程序运行中已启动） */
  var LAUNCHING = {};       /* game -> true（正在下载 / 注入） */
  var PAUSE_PENDING = {};   /* game -> true（暂停/继续请求已发出，等服务端刷新） */
  var FILTER = 'all';
  var SEARCH = '';
  var DETAIL_IDX = 0;
  var HERO_TIMER = null;

  function isVideoUrl(u){ return /\.(mp4|webm|ogv|m4v|mov)(\?.*)?$/i.test(u || ''); }

  /* 给每个游戏补一个 poster（不能是视频）：扫全部 cover，再退回 icon */
  function normalizeGames(){
    Object.keys(GAMES).forEach(function(k){
      var g = GAMES[k];
      if (!g.covers) g.covers = [];
      var list = g.covers.slice();
      list.push(g.img);
      g.poster = list.filter(function(u){ return u && !isVideoUrl(u); })[0] || g.img;
      if (!g.gen)  g.gen  = [];
      if (!g.feat) g.feat = [];
      if (!g.pub)  g.pub  = g.dev || '';
      if (!g.rel)  g.rel  = 'TBA';
    });
  }
  normalizeGames();

  /* 宿主在后台拉到新的 games.txt 时会推一份过来：就地换掉并重刷界面，不用重启 */
  function applyGamesUpdate(json, orderCsv){
    var next = null;
    try { next = (typeof json === 'string') ? JSON.parse(json) : json; } catch (e) { next = null; }
    if (!next || typeof next !== 'object') return false;
    var nextOrder = [];
    if (orderCsv) {
      String(orderCsv).split(',').forEach(function(x){ if (x) nextOrder.push(x); });
    }
    if (!nextOrder.length) nextOrder = Object.keys(next);

    GAMES = next;
    ORDER = nextOrder;
    normalizeGames();
    HERO_ORDER = (function(){
      var picked = ORDER.filter(function(g){ return !!(GAMES[g] && GAMES[g].featured); });
      return picked.length ? picked : ORDER.slice();
    })();
    HERO_POS = 0;
    HERO_GAME = HERO_ORDER[0] || '';
    /* 用户自己拖出来的顺序保留，新游戏排到后面 */
    var keep = [];
    GRID_ORDER.forEach(function(g){ if (GAMES[g] && keep.indexOf(g) < 0) keep.push(g); });
    ORDER.forEach(function(g){ if (keep.indexOf(g) < 0) keep.push(g); });
    GRID_ORDER = keep;

    if (typeof gpopHide === 'function') gpopHide();
    renderHero();
    renderGrid();
    renderQuickplay();
    renderGenreBtn();
    renderGenrePop();
    if (CURRENT_GAME && !GAMES[CURRENT_GAME]) closeDetail();
    if (typeof PANE !== 'undefined' && PANE.code && !GAMES[PANE.code]) paneHide();
    toast(uiT('gamesUpdated'), 'ok', 2600);
    return true;
  }


  var USER = (function(){
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem('starline.user');
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {}
    return { name: (UI_CFG && UI_CFG.account) || 'STARLINE User', avatar: '', dpi: 100, lang: '' };
  })();

  function doLogout(){ wv('ACC_LOGOUT'); }

  function saveUser(){
    try { localStorage.setItem('starline.user', JSON.stringify(USER)); }
    catch (e) {}
  }

  var WISHLIST = (function(){
    try {
      if (typeof UI_CFG !== 'undefined' && UI_CFG && Array.isArray(UI_CFG.wishlist))
        return UI_CFG.wishlist.slice();
    } catch (e) {}
    return [];
  })();


  function saveWishlist(){ wv('UI_WISH:' + WISHLIST.join(',')); }
  function isWished(g){ return WISHLIST.indexOf(g) >= 0; }

  /* ── 媒体轮播（网格浮层 + 列表右侧详情块共用一套逻辑）──────────────────
     图片每 3 秒自动换一张；视频不受 3 秒管，播完（或出错）再换；不能手动切。 */
  function carMake(shotId, videoId, dotsId){
    var ctx = { shot:shotId, video:videoId, dots:dotsId, code:'', items:[], idx:0, timer:0, on:false };
    var vid = document.getElementById(videoId);
    if (vid) {
      vid.addEventListener('ended', function(){ if (ctx.on) carNext(ctx); });
      vid.addEventListener('error', function(){ if (ctx.on) carNext(ctx); });
    }
    return ctx;
  }
  function carStop(ctx){
    if (!ctx) return;
    clearTimeout(ctx.timer);
    ctx.timer = 0;
    ctx.on = false;
    var vid = document.getElementById(ctx.video);
    if (vid) {
      try { vid.pause(); } catch (e) {}
      vid.removeAttribute('src');
      vid.classList.remove('on');
      try { vid.load(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    var img = document.getElementById(ctx.shot);
    if (img) { img.classList.remove('on'); img.style.backgroundImage = ''; }
    var dots = document.getElementById(ctx.dots);
    if (dots) dots.innerHTML = '';
  }
  function carNext(ctx){
    if (!ctx || !ctx.on || ctx.items.length < 2) return;
    ctx.idx = (ctx.idx + 1) % ctx.items.length;
    carPaint(ctx);
  }
  function carPaint(ctx){
    if (!ctx || !ctx.on) return;
    clearTimeout(ctx.timer);
    ctx.timer = 0;                  /* 视频那一档不挂计时器，这里必须是 0 */
    var url = ctx.items[ctx.idx] || '';
    var img = document.getElementById(ctx.shot);
    var vid = document.getElementById(ctx.video);
    var dots = document.getElementById(ctx.dots);
    var isVid = url && typeof isVideoUrl === 'function' && isVideoUrl(url);
    var token = ctx.idx;
    function loadDone(box){ if (box) box.classList.remove('loading'); }
    if (dots) {
      var dh = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < ctx.items.length; i++)
        dh += '<i class="' + (i === ctx.idx ? 'on' : '') + '"></i>';
      dots.innerHTML = ctx.items.length > 1 ? dh : '';
    }
    if (isVid) {
      if (img) { img.classList.remove('on'); img.style.backgroundImage = ''; }
      if (vid) {
        var vbox = vid.parentNode;
        if (vbox) vbox.classList.add('loading');
        if (vid.getAttribute('src') !== url) vid.setAttribute('src', url);
        try { vid.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {}
        var mark = function(){ if (token === ctx.idx) { vid.classList.add('on'); loadDone(vbox); } };
        vid.addEventListener('loadeddata', mark);
        vid.addEventListener('canplay', mark);
        vid.addEventListener('error', mark);
        var pr = vid.play();
        if (pr && pr.catch) pr.catch(function(){});
      }
    } else {
      if (vid) { try { vid.pause(); } catch (e) {} vid.classList.remove('on'); }
      if (img) {
        var ibox = img.parentNode;
        if (ibox) ibox.classList.add('loading');     /* 加载期间显示流光 */
        (function (el, box, u, tk) {
          var pre = new Image();
          var done = function(){
            if (tk !== ctx.idx) return;              /* 已经切到别的媒体了 */
            el.style.backgroundImage = "url('" + u + "')";
            el.classList.add('on');
            loadDone(box);
          };
          pre.onload = done;
          pre.onerror = done;
          pre.src = u;
        })(img, ibox, url, token);
      }
      if (ctx.items.length > 1) ctx.timer = setTimeout(function(){ carNext(ctx); }, 3000);
    }
  }
  function carStart(ctx, code, items){
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.code = code || '';
    ctx.items = items || [];
    ctx.idx = 0;
    ctx.on = ctx.items.length > 0;
    carPaint(ctx);
  }
  /* 某款游戏详情页那套媒体；一个都没有就退回海报/图标 */
  function mediaItems(g){
    var items = (typeof detailCovers === 'function') ? detailCovers(g) : [];
    if (!items.length) {
      var m = GAMES[g] || {};
      if (m.poster) items = [m.poster];
      else if (m.img) items = [m.img];
    }
    return items;
  }
  function metaBits(meta, code){
    var bits = [];
    if (meta.dev) bits.push(meta.dev);
    var gens = (meta.gen || []).slice(0, 3).map(function(x){ return tagT(x); }).join(' · ');
    if (gens) bits.push(gens);
    if (meta.rel) bits.push(relT(meta.rel));
    return bits.join('  ·  ') || code || '';
  }
  function statsInto(code, weekId, totalId){
    var m = GAMES[code] || {};
    var w = document.getElementById(weekId), t = document.getElementById(totalId);
    var wk = Math.max(0, Number(m.runsWeek) || 0);
    var tt = Math.max(0, Number(m.runs) || 0);
    if (w) { w.textContent = String(wk); w.classList.toggle('hot', wk > 0); }
    if (t) t.textContent = String(tt);
  }

  /* ── 网格模式：悬停卡片浮出的预览 ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  var GPOP = { code:'', showT:0, hideT:0, on:false, car:null };

  function gpopNode(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function gpopHide(){
    clearTimeout(GPOP.showT); clearTimeout(GPOP.hideT);
    GPOP.on = false; GPOP.code = '';
    var p = gpopNode('gpop');
    if (p) p.classList.remove('show');
    if (GPOP.car) carStop(GPOP.car);
  }

  function gpopPlace(card){
    var p = gpopNode('gpop');
    if (!p || !card) return;
    var r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    var pw = p.offsetWidth || 320;
    var ph = p.offsetHeight || Math.max(180, r.height);
    var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
    var x = r.right + 14;
    if (x + pw > vw - 10) {
      x = r.left - 14 - pw;
      if (x < 10) x = Math.max(10, Math.min(vw - pw - 10, r.left + (r.width - pw) / 2));
    }
    /* 高度和卡片一样，所以顶部直接对齐卡片 */
    var y = Math.max(10, Math.min(vh - ph - 10, r.top));
    p.style.left = Math.round(x) + 'px';
    p.style.top = Math.round(y) + 'px';
  }

  function gpopShow(card){
    if (!card) return;
    if (LAYOUT === 'list') return;                      /* 列表模式用右侧那块，不弹浮层 */
    if (typeof DND !== 'undefined' && DND) return;      /* 卡片拖拽中不弹 */
    if (typeof SDND !== 'undefined' && SDND) return;
    var code = card.getAttribute('data-game');
    if (!code || !GAMES[code]) return;
    var items = mediaItems(code);
    if (!items.length) return;

    GPOP.code = code;
    GPOP.on = true;
    var meta = GAMES[code] || {};
    var tEl = gpopNode('gpopTitle'), sEl = gpopNode('gpopSub');
    if (tEl) tEl.textContent = meta.title || code;
    if (sEl) sEl.textContent = metaBits(meta, code);
    statsInto(code, 'gpopWeek', 'gpopTotal');
    carStart(GPOP.car, code, items);
    var p = gpopNode('gpop');
    p.classList.add('show');    /* 先上屏才能量到真实宽高；同一帧内完成不会闪 */
    /* 高度跟卡片一致；卡片矮（每行 3/4/5/6 张）时切到紧凑版，别让内容溢出 */
    var h = Math.max(180, Math.round(card.getBoundingClientRect().height));
    p.style.height = h + 'px';
    p.classList.toggle('compact', h < 300);
    p.classList.toggle('tiny', h < 236);
    gpopPlace(card);
  }
  /* 启动成功后宿主会回新的计数，这里就地刷新 */
  function gpopRefreshStats(code){
    if (GPOP.on && code && GPOP.code === code) statsInto(code, 'gpopWeek', 'gpopTotal');
    if (PANE.code && code && PANE.code === code) statsInto(code, 'paneWeek', 'paneTotal');
  }

  /* ── 列表模式：右侧常驻的详情块（照 Steam 商店列表那样）────────────────
     鼠标停在哪一行就显示哪一行；移开列表后保持“最后一次悬停”的内容
     （第一次进列表、还没悬停过时显示第一个游戏）。
     媒体不做轮换：一张图/视频一行，全部列出来，没加载完有流光动画。 */
  var PANE = { code:'' };

  function paneMedia(code){
    var box = gpopNode('paneMedia');
    if (!box) return;
    var items = mediaItems(code);
    box.innerHTML = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      var u = items[i];
      if (typeof isVideoUrl === 'function' && isVideoUrl(u)) {
        var v = document.createElement('video');
        v.className = 'm';
        v.muted = true; v.loop = true; v.defaultMuted = true;
        v.setAttribute('muted', '');
        v.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
        v.preload = 'metadata';
        v.addEventListener('loadeddata', function(){ this.classList.add('loaded'); });
        v.addEventListener('canplay',    function(){ this.classList.add('loaded'); });
        v.addEventListener('error',      function(){ this.classList.add('loaded'); });
        v.src = u;
        box.appendChild(v);
        var pr = v.play();
        if (pr && pr.catch) pr.catch(function(){});
      } else {
        var d = document.createElement('div');
        d.className = 'm';
        box.appendChild(d);
        (function (el, url) {
          var pre = new Image();
          var done = function(){ el.style.backgroundImage = "url('" + url + "')"; el.classList.add('loaded'); };
          pre.onload = done;
          pre.onerror = done;
          pre.src = url;
        })(d, u);
      }
    }
    box.scrollTop = 0;
  }
  function paneFill(code){
    var box = gpopNode('gamePane');
    if (!box || !code || !GAMES[code]) return;
    if (PANE.code === code && !box.hidden) return;      /* 同一款游戏不用重画 */
    PANE.code = code;
    var meta = GAMES[code] || {};
    var tEl = gpopNode('paneTitle'), sEl = gpopNode('paneSub');
    if (tEl) tEl.textContent = meta.title || code;
    if (sEl) sEl.textContent = metaBits(meta, code);
    statsInto(code, 'paneWeek', 'paneTotal');
    paneMedia(code);
  }
  /* 把右侧块撑到当前可用高度（滚动/改变窗口大小都重算）：媒体区吃掉多余空间 */
  function paneFit(){
    var box = gpopNode('gamePane');
    if (!box || box.hidden) return;
    var top = box.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    var avail = window.innerHeight - top - 12;
    var h = Math.max(380, Math.min(avail, window.innerHeight - 20));
    box.style.height = Math.round(h) + 'px';
  }
  var paneFitRaf = 0;
  function paneFitSoon(){
    if (paneFitRaf) return;
    paneFitRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){ paneFitRaf = 0; paneFit(); });
  }
  function paneShow(firstCode){
    var box = gpopNode('gamePane');
    if (!box) return;
    if (!firstCode || !GAMES[firstCode]) { paneHide(); return; }
    box.hidden = false;
    paneFill(firstCode);
    paneFit();
    paneFitSoon();
  }
  function paneHide(){
    var box = gpopNode('gamePane');
    if (box) box.hidden = true;
    var media = gpopNode('paneMedia');
    if (media) {
      var vids = media.querySelectorAll('video');
      for (var v = 0; v < vids.length; v++) { try { vids[v].pause(); } catch (e) {} }
      media.innerHTML = '';
    }
    PANE.code = '';
  }

  function gpopBind(){
    GPOP.car = carMake('gpopShot', 'gpopVideo', 'gpopDots');
    var grid = document.getElementById('grid');
    if (!grid || grid.getAttribute('data-gpop') === '1') return;
    grid.setAttribute('data-gpop', '1');
    grid.addEventListener('mouseover', function(e){
      var card = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.card[data-game]') : null;
      if (!card) return;
      var code = card.getAttribute('data-game');
      if (LAYOUT === 'list') {                   /* 列表：右侧那块换成这一行 */
        if (code && code !== PANE.code) paneFill(code);
        return;
      }
      if (GPOP.on && GPOP.code === code) { clearTimeout(GPOP.hideT); return; }
      clearTimeout(GPOP.hideT);
      clearTimeout(GPOP.showT);
      GPOP.showT = setTimeout(function(){ gpopShow(card); }, 220);   /* 路过不弹，停一下才弹 */
    });
    grid.addEventListener('mouseout', function(e){
      var card = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.card[data-game]') : null;
      if (!card) return;
      var to = e.relatedTarget;
      if (to && to.closest && to.closest('.card[data-game]') === card) return;
      if (LAYOUT === 'list') return;             /* 列表：移开后保持最后一次悬停的内容 */
      clearTimeout(GPOP.showT);
      GPOP.hideT = setTimeout(gpopHide, 120);
    });
    var page = document.getElementById('storePage');
    if (page) page.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
      if (GPOP.on) gpopHide();
      if (LAYOUT === 'list') paneFitSoon();
    }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ if (LAYOUT === 'list') paneFitSoon(); });
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(){ if (GPOP.on) gpopHide(); }, true);
    window.addEventListener('blur', function(){ if (GPOP.on) gpopHide(); });
  }
  /* 列表里第一个（当前筛选后能看到的）游戏代号 */
  function gridFirstCode(){
    var first = document.querySelector('#grid .card[data-game]');
    return first ? first.getAttribute('data-game') : '';
  }

  function toggleWish(ev, g){
    if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
    if (!g) return;
    var i = WISHLIST.indexOf(g);
    var added = false;
    if (i >= 0) {
      WISHLIST.splice(i, 1);
      toast(uiT('wishRemoved'), 'info', 5000, {action:{label:uiT('toastUndo'), run:function(){
        if (WISHLIST.indexOf(g) >= 0) return;
        WISHLIST.splice(Math.min(i, WISHLIST.length), 0, g);
        saveWishlist(); renderHeroWish(); renderGrid();
        if (CURRENT_GAME) renderDetailWish();
      }}});
    } else {
      WISHLIST.push(g);
      added = true;
      toast(uiT('wishAdded'), 'ok', 2000);
    }
    saveWishlist();
    renderHeroWish();
    renderGrid();
    if (CURRENT_GAME) renderDetailWish();
    if (added) {
      var btn = document.querySelector('.card-wish[data-game="' + g + '"]');
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.add('pop');
        setTimeout(function(){ btn.classList.remove('pop'); }, 600);
      }
    }
  }



  function renderDetailWish(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('detailWish');
    var txt = document.getElementById('detailWishText');
    if (!btn || !txt) return;
    if (isWished(CURRENT_GAME)) {
      btn.classList.add('wished');
      txt.textContent = uiT('wishlisted');
    } else {
      btn.classList.remove('wished');
      txt.textContent = uiT('wishlist');
    }
  }

  function wv(m){
    try { window.chrome.webview.postMessage(m); }
    catch (e) {}
  }

  function licOf(g){
    return (LICENSES && LICENSES.games && LICENSES.games[g]) || null;
  }
  function hasLic(g){
    var l = licOf(g);
    return !!l && !!l.type;
  }

  /* 名下有任意一个还在有效期内的订阅（宿主给的 LICENSES 里只会有有效授权） */
  function hasActiveSub(){
    if (!LICENSES || !LICENSES.games) { return false; }
    for (var g in LICENSES.games) {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LICENSES.games, g) && hasLic(g)) { return true; }
    }
    return false;
  }
  /* 个人资料头像旁的 PRO 徽标：有订阅才显示 */
  function updateProfileBadges(){
    var box = document.getElementById('profileBadges');
    if (!box) { return; }
    box.hidden = !hasActiveSub();
  }

  /* 单游戏显示价（USD）：取 games.txt 里最便宜的那档（7 → 15 → 30 → 90 → 永久），
     都没写就回退默认价。**显式写 0 = 免费**（宿主会带上 free7/free15/free30/free90/freeLife
     标记，不能只看数值，否则 0 会被当成“没设定”而回退成默认价）。 */
  var PRICE_DEFAULT = 19.99;
  function priceNum(v){
    return (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && v > 0) ? v : 0;
  }
  function isFreePlan(g, plan){
    var m = GAMES[g] || {};
    return !!m['free' + plan];
  }
  function priceOf(g){
    var m = GAMES[g] || {};
    if (m.free7)  return 0;
    if (priceNum(m.price7))  return priceNum(m.price7);
    if (m.free15) return 0;
    if (priceNum(m.price15)) return priceNum(m.price15);
    if (m.free30) return 0;
    if (priceNum(m.price30)) return priceNum(m.price30);
    if (m.free90) return 0;
    if (priceNum(m.price90)) return priceNum(m.price90);
    if (m.freeLife) return 0;
    if (priceNum(m.priceLife)) return priceNum(m.priceLife);
    return PRICE_DEFAULT;
  }
  function priceFor(g){ return priceOf(g); }
  function isFreeGame(g){ return priceOf(g) <= 0; }
  /* games.txt 的 discount（百分比，默认 0 = 不打折；有效 1~99）。免费游戏不显示折扣。 */
  function discOf(g){
    if (isFreeGame(g)) return 0;
    var d = Math.round(Number((GAMES[g] || {}).discount));
    return (isFinite(d) && d > 0 && d < 100) ? d : 0;
  }
  /* 折后价（保留两位小数，按分四舍五入） */
  function salePriceOf(g){
    var p = priceOf(g), d = discOf(g);
    return d ? Math.round(p * (100 - d)) / 100 : p;
  }
  function fmtPrice(g){ return isFreeGame(g) ? uiT('free') : '$' + salePriceOf(g).toFixed(2); }
  /* 划线原价：只有真的打折才有（以前是 价格×1.1 的假原价，已去掉） */
  function fmtOldPrice(g){
    return discOf(g) ? '$' + priceOf(g).toFixed(2) : '';
  }


  var TOAST_ICONS = {
    ok:   '<path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/>',
    err:  '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7.5v5.5"/><path d="M12 16.6v.01"/>',
    warn: '<path d="M12 3.5L2.5 20h19L12 3.5z"/><path d="M12 10v4.5"/><path d="M12 17.6v.01"/>',
    info: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11.4v5.1"/><circle cx="12" cy="7.9" r="1.15" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>'
  };
  function toast(text, type, ms, opts){
    type = TOAST_ICONS[type] ? type : 'info';
    opts = opts || {};
    var acts = opts.actions || (opts.action ? [opts.action] : []);
    ms = ms || (acts.length ? 6000 : 3200);
    var wrap = document.getElementById('toastWrap');
    if (!wrap) { return function(){}; }
    while (wrap.children.length >= 3) { wrap.removeChild(wrap.firstChild); }
    var t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'toast ' + type;
    t.setAttribute('role', type === 'err' ? 'alert' : 'status');
    t.style.setProperty('--toast-ms', ms + 'ms');
    t.innerHTML = '<span class="toast-ico"><svg class="toast-ring" viewBox="0 0 34 34"><circle class="tk" cx="17" cy="17" r="14"/><circle class="bar" cx="17" cy="17" r="14"/></svg><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' + TOAST_ICONS[type] + '</svg></span><span class="toast-txt"></span>';
    t.querySelector('.toast-txt').textContent = text;
    var timer = 0, left = ms, started = 0, done = false;
    function close(){
      if (done) { return; }
      done = true; clearTimeout(timer);
      t.classList.add('out');
      setTimeout(function(){ if (t.parentNode) { t.parentNode.removeChild(t); } }, 300);
    }
    function arm(){ started = Date.now(); clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(close, left); }
    if (acts.length) {
      var box = document.createElement('span'); box.className = 'toast-acts';
      acts.forEach(function(a){
        if (!a || !a.label) { return; }
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'toast-act' + (a.ghost ? ' ghost' : ''); b.textContent = a.label;
        b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); close(); try { if (a.run) { a.run(); } } catch (err) {} });
        box.appendChild(b);
      });
      t.appendChild(box);
      /* 带按钮的提示：鼠标停在上面时暂停倒计时，方便点击 */
      t.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ if (done) { return; } clearTimeout(timer); left -= Date.now() - started; t.classList.add('paused'); });
      t.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ if (done) { return; } t.classList.remove('paused'); arm(); });
    }
    wrap.appendChild(t);
    arm();
    return close;
  }


  window.uiToast = function(text, type, ms, opts){ return toast(text, type, ms, opts); };

  function fmtDuration(sec){
    if (sec < 0) return 'LIFETIME';
    var d = Math.floor(sec / 86400);
    var h = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600);
    var m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
    if (d > 0) return d + 'd ' + h + 'h';
    if (h > 0) return h + 'h ' + m + 'm';
    return m + 'm';
  }

  /* 给右下角拖拽手柄用：窗口尺寸换算、下发、复位（RESIZE 的单位与 applyDPI 一致） */
  window.uiWinGeom = {
    scale: function(){ return Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2, ((USER && USER.dpi) || 100) / 100)); },
    min: function(){ return [640, 480]; },
    max: function(){
      try { return [window.screen.availWidth - 8, window.screen.availHeight - 8]; }
      catch (e) { return [4096, 4096]; }
    },
    send: function(w, h){ wv('RESIZE:' + w + 'x' + h); },
    reset: function(){ applyDPI((USER && USER.dpi) || 100); }
  };

  function applyDPI(dpi){
    var scale = (dpi || 100) / 100;
    if (scale < 0.5) scale = 0.5;
    if (scale > 2)   scale = 2;
    document.body.style.zoom = '';
    try {
      var sw = window.screen.availWidth;
      var sh = window.screen.availHeight;
      var baseW = 1100;
      var baseH = 700;
      var w = Math.round(baseW * scale);
      var h = Math.round(baseH * scale);
      if (w > sw - 8) w = sw - 8;
      if (h > sh - 8) h = sh - 8;
      if (w < 640) w = 640;
      if (h < 480) h = 480;
      wv('RESIZE:' + w + 'x' + h);
      setTimeout(function(){
        wv('SET_ZOOM:' + scale.toFixed(3));
      }, 60);
    } catch (e) {}
  }


  function applyUser(){
    var name = USER.name || 'STARLINE User';
    var initial = name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'S';
    var av = document.getElementById('profileAvatar');
    var tbAv = document.getElementById('tbAvatar');
    if (USER.avatar) {
      av.innerHTML = '<img src="' + USER.avatar + '" alt="">';
      tbAv.innerHTML = '<img src="' + USER.avatar + '" alt="">';
    } else {
      av.innerHTML = '<span id="profileAvatarText">' + initial + '</span>';
      tbAv.textContent = initial;
    }
    document.getElementById('profileName').textContent = name;
    updateProfileBadges();      /* 有订阅才显示 PRO */
  }

  function renderHero(){
    var n = HERO_ORDER.length;
    if (!n) return;
    HERO_PENDING = -1;
    if (HERO_POS >= n) HERO_POS = 0;
    HERO_GAME = HERO_ORDER[HERO_POS];
    heroSetPanel(HERO_PANEL_EL(), HERO_GAME);
    heroSetPanel(HERO_OTHER_EL(), HERO_GAME);   /* 备用面板先对齐，切换时再换成目标游戏 */
    heroPlace(HERO_PANEL_EL(), 0);
    heroPlace(HERO_OTHER_EL(), 0);
    heroRenderDots();
  }


  /* ── banner 轮播：整块面板左右滑动 ──────────────────────────────────────
     每个精选做成一张整块面板（背景图 + 文字 + 按钮 + 价格徽标），
     切换时两张面板一起平移：下一张 → 整块向左移出、新的从右移入；
     上一张 → 整块向右移出、新的从左移入。动画结束后把内容并回一张面板，
     于是可以一直朝同一个方向循环，不会出现反向跳帧。
     圆点在面板之外（#heroNav），固定显示在左下角不跟着滑动。 */
  var HERO_ANIM_MS = 480;          /* 与 .hero-panel.anim 的 transition 时长一致 */
  var HERO_SLIDE_TK = 0;
  var HERO_SLIDE_TIMER = 0;
  var HERO_ANIMATING = false;
  var HERO_PENDING = -1;           /* 动画中收到的切换请求，落位后补做 */

  function heroN(){ return HERO_ORDER.length; }

  function heroPanelEls(){
    return [
      document.getElementById('heroPanelA'),
      document.getElementById('heroPanelB')
    ];
  }
  /* 当前显示的面板保持“奇数/偶数”交替，两张轮流当进出面板 */
  function HERO_PANEL_EL(){
    var els = heroPanelEls();
    return els[HERO_PANEL_IDX % 2];
  }
  function HERO_OTHER_EL(){
    var els = heroPanelEls();
    return els[(HERO_PANEL_IDX + 1) % 2];
  }
  var HERO_PANEL_IDX = 0;



  /* 直接设置面板位移（不带动画）*/
  function heroPlace(el, x){
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('anim');
    el.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)';
  }

  /* 按语言取标签文字（面板内容是在 JS 里拼的，所以要手动翻译）*/
  function heroLabel(key, fallback){
    var v = uiT(key);
    return (v && v !== key) ? v : fallback;
  }
  /* 价格徽标的折扣文案：uiT 里没有对应词条时用默认值 */
  function heroDiscLabel(){
    var v = uiT('discount');
    return (v && v !== 'discount') ? v : '-10%';
  }

  /* 把一张面板填成指定游戏：图片、文字、按钮、价格一起换 */
  function heroSetPanel(el, gid){
    if (!el) return;
    var g = GAMES[gid];
    if (!g) return;
    var wished = isWished(gid);
    var owned = hasLic(gid);
    var metaTxt = g.dev || '';
    for (var k = 0; k < (g.gen || []).length; k++){
      metaTxt += (metaTxt ? ' \u00B7 ' : '') + g.gen[k];
    }
    var p = priceFor(gid);
    el.setAttribute('data-game', gid);
    /* 先让 buildSlide 设好背景（它会清空 innerHTML），再铺面板内容。
       海报挂了就退回 icon，避免出现空白 banner。 */
    buildSlide(el, g.poster || g.img || '', g.img || '');
    el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
      '<div class="hero-overlay" onclick="heroOpenDetail(event)"></div>'
      + '<div class="hero-body">'
      +   '<div class="hero-info">'
      +     '<div class="hero-tag">' + uiEsc(heroLabel('featured', 'Featured')) + gameStatusChip(g, 'hero-st') + '</div>'
      +     '<div class="hero-title"></div>'
      +     '<div class="hero-meta"></div>'
      +   '</div>'
      +   '<div class="hero-actions">'
      +     '<button class="btn btn-primary" data-hero-h="buy" onclick="onHeroBuy()">'
      +       '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>'
      +       '<span></span>'
      +     '</button>'
      +     '<button class="btn btn-secondary' + (wished ? ' wished' : '') + '" data-hero-h="wish"'
      +       ' onclick="toggleWish(event,\'' + gid + '\')">'
      +       '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.84 4.61a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 0L12 5.67l-1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 7.78l1.06 1.06L12 21.23l7.78-7.78 1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.78z"/></svg>'
      +       '<span></span>'
      +     '</button>'
      +   '</div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="hero-badge">'
      + (isFreeGame(gid) ? '<span class="discount">' + uiEsc(uiT('free')) + '</span>'
         : (discOf(gid) ? '<span class="discount">-' + discOf(gid) + '%</span>' : ''))
      + (discOf(gid) ? '<span class="price-old">' + uiEsc(fmtOldPrice(gid)) + '</span>' : '')
      +   '<span class="price-new' + (isFreeGame(gid) ? ' free' : '') + '">' + uiEsc(fmtPrice(gid)) + '</span>'
      + '</div>');



    var q = function(sel){ return el.querySelector(sel); };
    q('.hero-title').textContent = g.title || g.short || gid;
    q('.hero-meta').textContent = metaTxt;
    var buy = q('[data-hero-h="buy"] span');
    if (buy) buy.textContent = owned ? uiT('launch') : uiT('buyNow');
    var wish = q('[data-hero-h="wish"] span');
    if (wish) wish.textContent = wished ? uiT('wishlisted') : uiT('wishlist');
    el.classList.toggle('on', el === HERO_PANEL_EL());
  }

  /* 圆点在面板外面，是固定的一份，翻页时不会跟着滑走 */
  function heroRenderDots(){
    var nav = document.getElementById('heroNav');
    if (!nav) return;
    var html = '';
    for (var j = 0; j < heroN(); j++){
      var meta = GAMES[HERO_ORDER[j]];
      if (!meta) continue;
      var cls = (j === HERO_POS) ? 'hero-dot active' : 'hero-dot';
      /* data-nodrag + stopPropagation：点圆点只切换 banner，不会跳进详情页 */
      html += '<button class="' + cls + '" data-nodrag'
            + ' onclick="event.stopPropagation();heroGo(' + j + ')"'
            + ' title="' + uiEsc(meta.title || HERO_ORDER[j]) + '"></button>';
    }
    nav.innerHTML = html;
  }



  function heroRefreshDots(){
    var nav = document.getElementById('heroNav');
    if (!nav) return;
    var dots = nav.children;
    for (var k = 0; k < dots.length; k++){
      dots[k].classList.toggle('active', k === HERO_POS);
    }
  }

  /* 当前面板里的愿望按钮状态（呼应 toggleWish 后的刷新）*/
  function renderHeroWish(){
    var el = HERO_PANEL_EL();
    if (!el) return;
    var btn = el.querySelector('[data-hero-h="wish"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var span = btn.querySelector('span');
    var wished = isWished(HERO_GAME);
    btn.classList.toggle('wished', wished);
    if (span) span.textContent = wished ? uiT('wishlisted') : uiT('wishlist');
  }

  /* 切换完成后：把目标内容并回当前面板，两张面板归位 */
  function heroSlideSettle(target, nextIdx){
    var cur = HERO_PANEL_EL(), other = HERO_OTHER_EL();
    heroSetPanel(cur, HERO_ORDER[target]);
    HERO_PANEL_IDX = nextIdx;
    heroPlace(cur, 0);
    heroPlace(other, 0);
    HERO_ANIMATING = false;
    HERO_POS = target;
    HERO_GAME = HERO_ORDER[target];
    heroRefreshDots();
    /* 动画期间被挡下的那次切换（自动轮播/连点）现在补上 */
    if (HERO_PENDING >= 0){
      var p = HERO_PENDING;
      HERO_PENDING = -1;
      heroGo(p);
    }
  }



  /* 第 i 个精选；dir>0 下一张（向左滑），dir<0 上一张（向右滑）*/
  function heroGoDir(i, dir){
    var n = heroN();
    if (!n) return;
    var target = ((i % n) + n) % n;
    if (target === HERO_POS) return;

    var cur = HERO_PANEL_EL(), other = HERO_OTHER_EL();
    if (!cur || !other || n < 2){                     /* 只有一个精选：直接换内容 */
      heroSetPanel(cur, HERO_ORDER[target]);
      HERO_POS = target;
      HERO_GAME = HERO_ORDER[target];
      heroRefreshDots();
      return;
    }

    if (HERO_ANIMATING){                              /* 正在滑：记住这次请求，落位后补做 */
      HERO_PENDING = i;
      return;
    }

    var w = cur.offsetWidth || 1;
    var sgn = (dir < 0) ? -1 : 1;
    HERO_ANIMATING = true;

    /* 新的一块摆到入场位置，再让两块一起平移 */
    heroSetPanel(other, HERO_ORDER[target]);
    other.classList.remove('on');
    heroPlace(other, sgn * w);



    var tk = ++HERO_SLIDE_TK;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      if (tk !== HERO_SLIDE_TK) return;
      cur.classList.add('anim');
      other.classList.add('anim');
      cur.style.transform   = 'translateX(' + (-sgn * w) + 'px)';
      other.style.transform = 'translateX(0px)';
    });

    clearTimeout(HERO_SLIDE_TIMER);
    HERO_SLIDE_TIMER = setTimeout(function(){
      if (tk !== HERO_SLIDE_TK) return;
      heroSlideSettle(target, (HERO_PANEL_IDX + 1) % 2);
    }, HERO_ANIM_MS + 90);
  }

  /* 自动轮播 / 圆点直达：按距离选方向，保证动画方向合理 */
  function heroGo(i){
    var n = heroN();
    if (!n) return;
    var target = ((i % n) + n) % n;
    if (target === HERO_POS) return;
    if (HERO_ANIMATING){ HERO_PENDING = i; return; }   /* 别丢掉这一拍 */
    var nf = (target - HERO_POS + n) % n;             /* 向前几步 */
    var nb = (HERO_POS - target + n) % n;             /* 向后几步 */
    heroGoDir(target, nf <= nb ? 1 : -1);
  }



  function heroPrev(ev){ if (ev) ev.stopPropagation(); heroGoDir(HERO_POS - 1, -1); }
  function heroNext(ev){ if (ev) ev.stopPropagation(); heroGoDir(HERO_POS + 1, 1); }

  /* 窗口尺寸变化时把两张面板归位（此时没有动画在进行）*/
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    if (HERO_ANIMATING) return;
    heroPlace(HERO_PANEL_EL(), 0);
    heroPlace(HERO_OTHER_EL(), 0);
  });

  function startHeroTimer(){
    if (HERO_TIMER) clearInterval(HERO_TIMER);
    HERO_TIMER = setInterval(function(){
      if (document.getElementById('storePage').hidden) return;
      if (heroN() < 2) return;
      /* 页面被切到后台时浏览器不跑 transition，等回来再翻，免得"没动画" */
      if (document.hidden){ setTimeout(function(){ heroGo(HERO_POS + 1); }, 600); return; }
      heroGo(HERO_POS + 1);
    }, 7000);
  }

  var LAYOUT = (UI_CFG && UI_CFG.layout === 'list') ? 'list' : 'grid';



  var GRID_ORDER = (function(){

    ORDER.forEach(function(g){ if (out.indexOf(g) < 0) out.push(g); });

  })();
  function saveGridOrder(){ wv('UI_GORDER:' + GRID_ORDER.join(',')); }

  /* ── 按 Genres 筛选 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
     GENRE = '' 表示不筛；与 All/Owned/Available/Wishlist 是「与」关系 */
  var GENRE = '';

  /* 收集目录里出现过的所有类型（按名字排序，去重） */
  function allGenres(){
    var seen = {}, out = [];
    ORDER.forEach(function(g){
      var meta = GAMES[g];
      if (!meta || !meta.gen) return;
      meta.gen.forEach(function(x){
        var v = String(x || '').trim();
        if (!v || seen[v.toLowerCase()]) return;
        seen[v.toLowerCase()] = 1;
        out.push(v);
      });
    });
    out.sort(function(a, b){ return a.toLowerCase() < b.toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1; });
    return out;
  }
  function renderGenreBtn(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('genreBtn');
    var txt = document.getElementById('genreBtnTxt');
    if (!btn || !txt) return;
    if (GENRE) {
      /* 按钮视觉上只显示筛选图标；文字保留为无障碍标签与提示 */
      txt.removeAttribute('data-ui');
      txt.textContent = tagT(GENRE);
      btn.classList.add('active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', uiT('genres') + ': ' + tagT(GENRE));
      btn.setAttribute('title', uiT('genres') + ': ' + tagT(GENRE));
    } else {
      txt.setAttribute('data-ui', 'genres');
      txt.textContent = uiT('genres');
      btn.classList.remove('active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', uiT('genres'));
      btn.setAttribute('title', uiT('genres'));
    }
  }
  function renderGenrePop(){
    var pop = document.getElementById('genrePop');
    if (!pop) return;
    var list = allGenres();
    var html = '<button type="button" data-genre=""' + (GENRE ? '' : ' class="active"') + '>'
      + '<svg class="tick" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>'
      + '<span>' + uiEsc(uiT('genreAll')) + '</span></button>';
    if (list.length) { html += '<div class="genre-sep"></div>'; }
    list.forEach(function(x){
      html += '<button type="button" data-genre="' + uiEsc(x) + '"'
        + (x === GENRE ? ' class="active"' : '') + '>'
        + '<svg class="tick" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>'
        + '<span>' + uiEsc(tagT(x)) + '</span></button>';
    });
    if (!list.length) { html += '<div class="genre-none">' + uiEsc(uiT('genreNone')) + '</div>'; }
    pop.innerHTML = html;
  }
  function openGenrePop(){
    var pop = document.getElementById('genrePop');
    var btn = document.getElementById('genreBtn');
    if (!pop) return;
    renderGenrePop();
    pop.hidden = false;
    if (btn) { btn.classList.add('open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); }
  }
  function closeGenrePop(){
    var pop = document.getElementById('genrePop');
    var btn = document.getElementById('genreBtn');
    if (pop) pop.hidden = true;
    if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
  }
  function genreOpen(){
    var p = document.getElementById('genrePop');
    if (!p || p.hidden) return false;
    /* 弹层在商店页里，商店页被隐藏时它其实也看不见 */
    var sp = document.getElementById('storePage');
    if (sp && sp.hidden) return false;
    return true;
  }
  function toggleGenrePop(ev){
    if (ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); }
    if (genreOpen()) closeGenrePop(); else openGenrePop();
  }
  function setGenre(x){
    GENRE = x || '';
    renderGenreBtn();
    renderGenrePop();
    closeGenrePop();
    renderGrid();
  }
  (function initGenrePop(){
    var pop = document.getElementById('genrePop');
    if (!pop) return;
    /* 类型名来自 games.txt，可能有引号，所以走 data 属性 + 委托，不拼 onclick */
    pop.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('button[data-genre]') : null;
      if (!b) return;
      setGenre(b.getAttribute('data-genre') || '');
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      if (!genreOpen()) return;
      var wrap = document.getElementById('genreWrap');
      if (wrap && wrap.contains(e.target)) return;
      closeGenrePop();
    }, true);
  })();

  var COLS_OPTS = ['auto', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6'];
  var COLS = (UI_CFG && COLS_OPTS.indexOf(String(UI_CFG.cols)) >= 0) ? String(UI_CFG.cols) : 'auto';

  function applyGridCols(){
    var grid = document.getElementById('grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    var fixed = (LAYOUT === 'grid' && COLS !== 'auto');
    grid.classList.toggle('cols-n', fixed);
    if (fixed) {
      grid.style.setProperty('--cols', COLS);
      grid.style.setProperty('--gap', (COLS === '6' ? 12 : COLS === '5' ? 14 : 20) + 'px');
    } else {
      grid.style.removeProperty('--cols');
      grid.style.removeProperty('--gap');
    }
  }
  function renderColsOpts(){
    var box = document.getElementById('colsChips');
    var row = document.getElementById('colsRow');
    if (!box || !row) return;
    var html = '';
    COLS_OPTS.forEach(function(c){
      html += '<button type="button" class="cols-chip' + (c === COLS ? ' active' : '') + '" '
            + 'onclick="setCols(\'' + c + '\')">'
            + (c === 'auto' ? uiEsc(uiT('colsAuto')) : c) + '</button>';
    });
    box.innerHTML = html;
    row.classList.toggle('disabled', LAYOUT !== 'grid');
  }
  function setCols(c){
    if (COLS_OPTS.indexOf(c) < 0 || c === COLS) return;
    COLS = c;
    wv('UI_COLS:' + c);
    renderColsOpts();
    applyGridCols();
    var grid = document.getElementById('grid');
    grid.classList.remove('relayout');
    void grid.offsetWidth;
    grid.classList.add('relayout');
    setTimeout(function(){ grid.classList.remove('relayout'); }, 450);
  }
  function renderLayoutOpts(){
    document.querySelectorAll('#layoutOpts .layout-opt').forEach(function(b){
      b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-layout') === LAYOUT);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#storeViewSwitch [data-store-layout]').forEach(function(b){
      var active = b.getAttribute('data-store-layout') === LAYOUT;
      b.classList.toggle('active', active);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      var key = active ? 'layout' + (LAYOUT === 'list' ? 'List' : 'Grid') : 'layout' + (b.getAttribute('data-store-layout') === 'list' ? 'List' : 'Grid');
      b.title = uiT(key);
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', uiT(key));
    });
    renderColsOpts();
  }
  function setLayout(mode){
    mode = (mode === 'list') ? 'list' : 'grid';
    if (mode === LAYOUT) { renderLayoutOpts(); return; }
    LAYOUT = mode;
    wv('UI_LAYOUT:' + LAYOUT);
    renderLayoutOpts();
    renderGrid();
  }


  function licPausable(g){
    var l = licOf(g);
    return !!(l && l.pausable && l.type !== 'LIFETIME');
  }
  /* 启动过（或正在启动）就不能再暂停；暂停中（或暂停请求处理中）不能再启动 */
  function pauseLockedByLaunch(g){
    var l = licOf(g);
    return !!(l && !l.paused && !PAUSE_PENDING[g] && (LAUNCHED[g] || LAUNCHING[g]));
  }
  function launchLockedByPause(g){
    var l = licOf(g);
    return !!(l && (l.paused || PAUSE_PENDING[g]));
  }
  function pauseIcon(paused){
    return paused
      ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="6 4 20 12 6 20 6 4"/></svg>'
      : '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="9" y1="5" x2="9" y2="19"/><line x1="15" y1="5" x2="15" y2="19"/></svg>';
  }
  /* 状态一变就刷新详情页里的「启动 / 暂停 / 继续」按钮 */
  function refreshPauseUi(g){
    if (!g || g !== CURRENT_GAME) return;
    if (hasLic(g)) updateSubDisplay(licOf(g));
    renderDetailHeroButtons(g);
  }
  function togglePause(ev, g){
    if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
    var l = licOf(g);
    if (!l || !licPausable(g)) return;
    if (PAUSE_PENDING[g]) return;
    /* 已经启动过的游戏不允许暂停；要暂停必须先关掉游戏、重开程序 */
    if (!l.paused && pauseLockedByLaunch(g)) {
      toast(uiT('pauseBlocked'), 'err', 3500);
      return;
    }
    PAUSE_PENDING[g] = true;
    refreshPauseUi(g);
    wv((l.paused ? 'RESUME_TIME:' : 'PAUSE_TIME:') + g);
  }

  var REQ_BUSY = false;

    var m = document.getElementById('reqModal');
    if (!m) return;
    document.getElementById('reqGame').value = (SEARCH || '').slice(0, 60);

  }

  /* ════════ What players say：网站后台已审核的评价 ════════ */
  var REVIEWS = null;        /* [{username, rating, content, date, avatar}] */
  var REV_BUSY = false;
  var REV_RATING = 5;
  var REV_FIRST = 3;         /* 首屏只显示 3 条 */
  var REV_STEP  = 6;         /* 每点一次「加载更多」再多 6 条（两行），要再点一次才继续 */
  var REV_LIMIT = 3;         /* 当前显示条数 */

  function renderReviews(){
    var box = document.getElementById('revList');
    var empty = document.getElementById('revEmpty');
    var more = document.getElementById('revMoreWrap');
    if (!box) return;
    var list = REVIEWS || [];
    if (!list.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '';
      if (more) more.hidden = true;
      if (empty) { empty.textContent = uiT('reviewEmpty'); empty.hidden = false; }
      return;
    }
    if (empty) empty.hidden = true;
    if (REV_LIMIT < REV_FIRST) REV_LIMIT = REV_FIRST;

    var n = Math.min(list.length, REV_LIMIT);
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var r = list[i] || {};
      var rating = parseInt(r.rating, 10);
      if (!isFinite(rating) || rating < 1) rating = 5;
      if (rating > 5) rating = 5;
      var stars = '';
      for (var s = 1; s <= 5; s++) { stars += (s <= rating) ? '★' : '☆'; }
      var name = String(r.username || '');
      var initial = (name.replace(/^\s+/, '').charAt(0) || '?').toUpperCase();
      var color = String(r.avatar || '');
      if (!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(color)) color = '#e8375a';
      html += '<div class="rev-card">'
        + '<div class="rev-stars-line">' + stars + '</div>'
        + '<div class="rev-text">“' + uiEsc(String(r.content || '')) + '”</div>'
        + '<div class="rev-author">'
        +   '<div class="rev-avatar" style="background:' + color + '">' + uiEsc(initial) + '</div>'
        +   '<div><div class="rev-name">' + uiEsc(name) + '</div>'
        +   '<div class="rev-meta">' + uiEsc(String(r.date || '')) + '</div></div>'
        + '</div></div>';
    }
    box.innerHTML = html;
    if (more) more.hidden = (list.length <= n);      /* 全显示完了就收起按钮 */
  }

  /* 加载更多：一次多两行（6 条），加载完还想看就再点一次 */
  function loadMoreReviews(){
    REV_LIMIT += REV_STEP;
    renderReviews();
  }

  /* 详情页每次打开都刷一次；宿主那边有 120 秒缓存，不会每次都跑网络 */
  function loadReviews(){
    if (!(REVIEWS && REVIEWS.length)) { renderReviews(); }
    wv('REVIEWS');
  }

  function openReviewModal(){
    var m = document.getElementById('revModal');
    if (!m) return;
    REV_RATING = 5;
    paintReviewStars();
    var t = document.getElementById('revText');
    if (t) { t.value = ''; t.classList.remove('is-err'); }
    revSetBusy(false);
    m.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(function(){ if (t) t.focus(); }, 120);
  }
  function closeReviewModal(){
    var m = document.getElementById('revModal');
    if (m) m.classList.remove('open');
  }
  function paintReviewStars(){
    var box = document.getElementById('revStars');
    if (!box) return;
    var btns = box.querySelectorAll('button');
    for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) { btns[i].classList.toggle('on', (i + 1) <= REV_RATING); }
  }
  function pickReviewStar(n){
    REV_RATING = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, n || 5));
    paintReviewStars();
  }
  function revSetBusy(b){
    REV_BUSY = b;
    var btn = document.getElementById('revSendBtn');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = b; btn.textContent = uiT(b ? 'reqSending' : 'reqSend'); }
  }
  function submitReview(){
    if (REV_BUSY) return;
    var t = document.getElementById('revText');
    var txt = String((t && t.value) || '')
      .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
    if (txt.length < 10) {
      if (t) { t.classList.add('is-err'); t.focus(); }
      toast(uiT('revErrShort'), 'err', 2500);
      return;
    }
    if (txt.length > 600) txt = txt.slice(0, 600);
    revSetBusy(true);
    wv('REVIEW_SUBMIT:' + REV_RATING + String.fromCharCode(31) + txt);
  }
