  /* ── 奖品展示 ── */
  function wPrizeParts(p){
    if (p.type === 'key') return { g: p.game, d: wDays(p.days), cls: 'key' };
    var nm = (p.name === 'Nothing' || !p.name) ? wT('none') : p.name;
    return { g: nm, d: '', cls: 'none' };
  }
  function wPct(p){ var v = Number(p.percent) || 0; return (v % 1 === 0 ? v : v.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '')) + '%'; }
  function wItemHtml(p, extra){
    var x = wPrizeParts(p);
    return '<div class="wh-item ' + x.cls + (extra || '') + '"><span class="g">' + wEsc(x.g) + '</span>' + (x.d ? '<span class="d">' + wEsc(x.d) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>';
  }
  function wheelReelCenter(){ var r = document.getElementById('whReel'); return r ? r.clientWidth / 2 : 400; }

  /* 空闲状态：奖品按顺序摆开，第一个对准指针；转起来时再换成长条 */
  function wheelRenderStrip(){
    var strip = document.getElementById('whStrip'); if (!strip) return;
    var P = WH.prizes;
    strip.style.transition = 'none';
    if (!P.length) { strip.innerHTML = '<div class="wh-empty" style="width:100%">' + wEsc(wT('noPrize')) + '</div>'; strip.style.transform = 'translateX(0)'; return; }
    var html = '', n = P.length, reps = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(14 / n));
    for (var r = 0; r < reps; r++) for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) html += wItemHtml(P[i]);
    strip.innerHTML = html;
    strip.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (wheelReelCenter() - WH_ITEM_W / 2) + 'px)';
  }
  function wheelRenderHist(){
    var box = document.getElementById('whHist'); if (!box) return;
    if (!WH.history.length) { box.innerHTML = '<div class="wh-empty">' + wEsc(wT('noHist')) + '</div>'; return; }
    var cp = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10"/></svg>';
    box.innerHTML = WH.history.map(function(h, i){
      return '<div class="wh-hrow"><div class="t"><div>' + wEsc(h.key ? (h.game + ' · ' + wDays(h.days)) : (h.name === 'Nothing' ? wT('none') : h.name)) + '</div>' +
        (h.key ? '<div class="k">' + wEsc(h.key) + (h.redeemed ? ' · <span class="u">' + wEsc(wT('used')) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' : '') + '</div>' +
        (h.key ? '<button class="wh-copy" type="button" onclick="wheelCopy(' + i + ')">' + cp + '</button>' : '') + '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── 复制 ── */
  function wheelCopyText(t){
    function fb(){ var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = t; ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0'; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {} ta.remove(); }
    try { if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).catch(fb); } else fb(); } catch (e) { fb(); }
    wSfx('copy'); toast(wT('copied'), 'ok', 1800);
  }
  function wheelCopy(i){ var h = WH.history[i]; if (h && h.key) wheelCopyText(h.key); }
  function wheelCopyLast(){ if (WH.lastKey) wheelCopyText(WH.lastKey); }

  /* ── 与宿主通信 ── */
  function wheelSend(action, arg){
    clearTimeout(WH.pend[action]);
    WH.pend[action] = setTimeout(function(){          /* 旧版客户端没有 WHEEL 桥接：不会有回复 */
      wheelLive(false);
      if (action === 'spin') { wheelSpinEnd(); wheelSay(wT('needUpdate'), true); wSfx('error'); }
    }, 9000);
    wv('WHEEL:' + action + (arg != null ? ':' + arg : ''));
  }
  function wheelOnRaw(act, body){
    clearTimeout(WH.pend[act]);
    var d = null; try { d = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
    if (!d) { wheelLive(false); if (act === 'spin') { wheelSpinEnd(); wheelSay(wT('e_ERR'), true); wSfx('error'); } return; }
    if (act === 'prizes') {
      if (!d.ok) { wheelLive(false); return; }
      wheelLive(true);
      if (WH.spinning) return;
      var changed = WH.loaded && d.rev !== WH.rev;
      WH.prizes = d.prizes || []; WH.rev = d.rev || ''; WH.loaded = true;
      wheelRenderStrip();
      if (changed) {
        wSfx('ping'); wheelSay(wT('updated'), false);
      }
    } else if (act === 'history') {
      if (d.ok) { WH.history = d.history || []; wheelRenderHist(); }
    } else if (act === 'spin') {
      if (!d.ok) {
        wheelSpinEnd(); wSfx('error');
        var em = wT('e_' + d.code) !== 'e_' + d.code ? wT('e_' + d.code) : (d.msg || wT('e_ERR'));
        if (d.detail) { em += ' [' + d.detail + ']'; try { console.error('wheel spin error:', d.detail); } catch (e) {} }
        wheelSay(em, true);
        return;
      }
      wheelAnimate(d);
    }
  }

  /* ── 转动 ── */
  function wheelSpinEnd(){
    WH.spinning = false;
    var b = document.getElementById('whSpin'); if (b) { b.disabled = false; b.querySelector('span').textContent = wT('spin'); }
  }
  function wheelSpin(){
    if (WH.spinning) return;
    var inp = document.getElementById('whTicket'), tk = (inp.value || '').replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
    wheelSay('', false);
    if (!tk) { wheelSay(wT('needTicket'), true); wSfx('error'); inp.focus(); return; }
    WH.spinning = true; wSfx('click');
    var b = document.getElementById('whSpin'); b.disabled = true; b.querySelector('span').textContent = wT('spinning');
    wheelSend('spin', tk);
  }

  function wheelAnimate(d){
    /* 用服务端这一次抽奖的奖品快照来滚，结果和画面一定对得上，即使后台刚好改过奖品 */
    WH.prizes = d.prizes || WH.prizes; WH.rev = d.rev || WH.rev;
    var P = WH.prizes, n = P.length, win = d.win_index | 0;
    var strip = document.getElementById('whStrip');
    var reps = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(70 / n) + 2), html = '';
    for (var r = 0; r < reps; r++) for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) html += wItemHtml(P[i]);
    strip.style.transition = 'none'; strip.innerHTML = html;
    var base = wheelReelCenter() - WH_ITEM_W / 2;
    strip.style.transform = 'translateX(' + base + 'px)'; void strip.offsetWidth;

    var targetIdx = (reps - 3) * n + win, unit = WH_ITEM_W + WH_GAP;
    var jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * (WH_ITEM_W * 0.6);                 /* 在中奖格内随机停，更像真的 */
    var endX = base - targetIdx * unit + jitter, dur = 5600;
    wSfx('start');
    strip.style.transition = 'transform ' + dur + 'ms cubic-bezier(.08,.62,.08,1)';
    strip.style.transform = 'translateX(' + endX + 'px)';

    var center = wheelReelCenter(), lastI = -1, t0 = performance.now(), done = false;
    function frame(){
      if (done) return;
      var m = new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(strip).transform), x = m.m41;
      var idx = Math.floor((center - x) / unit);
      if (idx !== lastI) { if (lastI !== -1) wSfx('tick', Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur)); lastI = idx; }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    var finished = false;
    function fin(){
      if (finished) return; finished = true; done = true;
      strip.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
      var el = strip.children[targetIdx]; if (el) el.classList.add('win');
      WH.history = d.history || WH.history; wheelRenderHist();
      document.getElementById('whTicket').value = '';
      setTimeout(function(){ wheelSpinEnd(); wheelResult(d); }, 450);
    }
    function onEnd(e){ if (e.target === strip && e.propertyName === 'transform') fin(); }
    strip.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
    setTimeout(fin, dur + 400);
  }

  function wheelResult(d){
    var p = d.prize || {}, big = document.getElementById('whPopBig'), sub = document.getElementById('whPopSub'),
        key = document.getElementById('whPopKey'), cp = document.getElementById('whPopCopy');
    WH.lastKey = d.key || '';
    if (d.key) {
      big.className = 'big'; big.textContent = wT('won');
      sub.textContent = p.game + ' · ' + wDays(p.days) + ' — ' + wT('yourKey');
      key.textContent = d.key; key.hidden = false; cp.hidden = false;
      wSfx('win'); wheelConfetti();
    } else {
      big.className = 'big lose'; big.textContent = wT('lost');
      sub.textContent = (p.name === 'Nothing' || !p.name) ? wT('none') : p.name;
      key.hidden = true; cp.hidden = true; wSfx('lose');
    }
    document.getElementById('whModal').classList.add('on');
  }
  function wheelCloseModal(){
    document.getElementById('whModal').classList.remove('on');
    var st = document.getElementById('whStrip'); if (st && !WH.spinning) wheelRenderStrip();
  }
  function wheelConfetti(){
    var box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'wh-confetti';
    var cols = ['#ff5d73', '#ffb84d', '#4ddc9a', '#4da3ff', '#b57bff', '#ffffff'];
    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      var s = document.createElement('i');
      s.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + '%'; s.style.background = cols[i % cols.length];
      s.style.animationDuration = (1.6 + Math.random() * 1.6) + 's'; s.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * .35) + 's';
      s.style.setProperty('--dx', ((Math.random() - .5) * 240) + 'px'); s.style.setProperty('--rot', (360 + Math.random() * 720) + 'deg');
      box.appendChild(s);
    }
    document.body.appendChild(box); setTimeout(function(){ box.remove(); }, 3800);
  }

  }

  /* 打开设置/续费/更新日志前，记住当前是哪一页、正在看哪个游戏
     关掉之后原路退回，而不是一律回到商店页 */
  var VIEW_FROM_PAGE = 'store';
  var VIEW_FROM_GAME = '';

  function onUiViewOpened(view){
    if (view === 'settings' || view === 'renew' || view === 'changelog') {
      VIEW_FROM_PAGE = currentPage();
      VIEW_FROM_GAME = CURRENT_GAME || '';
      closeDetail();
    }
  }

  /* ESC：详情页 → 返回上一页；个人资料 → 返回商店页 */
  function onUiEscBack(){
    /* Genres 弹层最先生效，ESC 先把它收掉 */
    if (typeof genreOpen === 'function' && genreOpen()) { closeGenrePop(); return true; }
    /* 视频全屏时 ESC 只退全屏，第二次 ESC 才关详情页 */
    if (dvExitFull()) { return true; }
    /* 弹窗 / 拖拽这类浮层自己会处理 ESC，别顺手把详情页也关掉 */
    var rm = document.getElementById('reqModal');
    if (rm && rm.classList.contains('open')) { return true; }
    if (typeof DND !== 'undefined' && DND) { return true; }
    if (typeof SDND !== 'undefined' && SDND) { return true; }
    var d = document.getElementById('detail');
    if (d && d.classList.contains('open')) { closeDetail(); return true; }
    if (currentPage() === 'profile') { showStore(); return true; }
    return false;
  }

  var RETURN_GAME = '';
  function onUiViewClosed(){
    var page = VIEW_FROM_PAGE, game = VIEW_FROM_GAME;
    VIEW_FROM_PAGE = 'store';
    VIEW_FROM_GAME = '';
    showPage(page);
    var back = RETURN_GAME || game;
    RETURN_GAME = '';
    if (back && GAMES[back]) { openDetail(back); }
  }

    }
    if (DV.video) dvPaint();     /* 视频控件的 title 跟着语言走 */
    renderHero();
    renderGrid();
    renderQuickplay();
    renderDownloads();
    renderGenreBtn();      /* 类型名/“Genres” 文案跟着语言走 */
    renderGenrePop();
    renderProfileLangs();
    renderLayoutOpts();
    renderBgOpts();
  }

  function renderBgOpts(){
    var tg = document.getElementById('bgFxToggle');
    var box = document.getElementById('bgStyles');
    if (!tg || !box) return;
    tg.checked = BGFX_ON;
    box.classList.toggle('disabled', !BGFX_ON);
    var html = '';
    BGFX_STYLES.forEach(function(k){
      var prev = '<span class="bg-prev p-' + k + '"'
        + (k === 'image' && BG_IMAGE ? ' style="background-image:url(\'' + BG_IMAGE + '\')"' : '') + '>'
        + (k === 'image' && !BG_IMAGE ? '+' : '') + '</span>';
      html += '<button type="button" class="bg-tile' + (k === BGFX_STYLE ? ' active' : '') + '" '
            + 'onclick="setBgStyle(\'' + k + '\')">' + prev
            + '<span class="bg-name">' + uiEsc(uiT(BGFX_NAME_KEY[k])) + '</span></button>';
    });
    box.innerHTML = html;
    var row = document.getElementById('bgImageRow');
    if (row) row.hidden = !BGFX_ON;
    var clr = document.getElementById('bgClearBtn');
    if (clr) clr.hidden = !BG_IMAGE;
  }

    BG_IMAGE = '';
    wv('UI_BGIMG_CLEAR');

    bgfxApply(); renderBgOpts();
  }

  function bgfxCompress(src, cb){
    var im = new Image();
    im.onload = function(){
      var w0 = im.naturalWidth, h0 = im.naturalHeight;
      if (!w0 || !h0) { cb(null); return; }
      var base = Math.min(1, 1920 / w0, 1200 / h0);
      var tries = [[1, .82], [1, .7], [.8, .7], [.65, .6], [.5, .55]];
      for (var i = 0; i < tries.length; i++) {
        var c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = Math.max(2, Math.round(w0 * base * tries[i][0]));
        c.height = Math.max(2, Math.round(h0 * base * tries[i][0]));
        var x = c.getContext('2d');
        if (!x) { cb(null); return; }
        x.fillStyle = '#0b0b0f'; x.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        x.drawImage(im, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        var out = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', tries[i][1]);
        if (out.length <= BGFX_MAX_CHARS - 2000) { cb(out); return; }
      }
      cb(null);
    };
    im.onerror = function(){ cb(null); };
    im.src = src;
  }
  (function(){
    var f = document.getElementById('bgFile');
    if (!f) return;
    f.addEventListener('change', function(){
      var file = f.files && f.files[0];
      f.value = '';
      if (!file) return;
      if (!/^image\//.test(file.type)) { toast(uiT('bgImageBad'), 'err', 2500); return; }
      var rd = new FileReader();
      rd.onerror = function(){ toast(uiT('bgImageBad'), 'err', 2500); };
      rd.onload = function(){
        bgfxCompress(String(rd.result), function(data){
          if (!data) { toast(uiT('bgImageBad'), 'err', 2500); return; }
          BG_IMAGE = data; BGFX_STYLE = 'image'; BGFX_ON = true;
          wv('UI_BGIMG:' + data);
          wv('UI_BGSTYLE:image');
          wv('UI_BGFX:1');
          bgfxApply(); renderBgOpts();
          toast(uiT('bgImageSet'), 'ok', 2000);
        });
      };
      rd.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  })();


  bgfxApply();

  var searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  /* 性能：每敲一个字就重建整片卡片（含重新加载封面图）会明显卡手
     这里做个防抖，停手 140ms 后再渲染一次。 */
  var searchTimer = 0;
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
    var v = this.value.trim();
    if (searchTimer) { clearTimeout(searchTimer); }
    searchTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      searchTimer = 0;
      if (v === SEARCH) { return; }
      SEARCH = v;
      renderGrid();
    }, 140);
  });

  document.getElementById('secFilter').addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    setFilter(btn.getAttribute('data-filter'));
  });

  function onHeroBuy(){
    if (hasLic(HERO_GAME)) {
      openDetail(HERO_GAME);
      setTimeout(function(){ jumpToInject(); }, 300);
    } else {
      renewGame(null, HERO_GAME);
    }
  }

  function renewGame(ev, g){
    if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
    /* 把“当前点的那个游戏”带进 Renew 页：价格、输入框前缀、封面/订阅时间都靠它 */
    var code = g || CURRENT_GAME || HERO_GAME || '';
    RETURN_GAME = CURRENT_GAME || '';
    if (typeof uiOpenRenew === 'function') uiOpenRenew(code);
  }

  function uiToggleTheme(){
    var cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
    var next = 'dark';
    if (cur === 'dark') next = 'light';
    if (typeof uiSetTheme === 'function') uiSetTheme(next);
  }


  window.chrome.webview.addEventListener('message', function(e){
    var msg = e.data;
    if (typeof msg !== 'string') return;

    if (msg.indexOf('LICENSES:') === 0) {
      try {
        LICENSES = JSON.parse(msg.slice(9));
        ACTIVE_GAME = LICENSES.active || ACTIVE_GAME;
        PAUSE_PENDING = {};             /* 服务端状态已回来，清掉「处理中」 */
        renderHero();
        renderGrid();
        renderQuickplay();
        renderDownloads();
        updateProfileBadges();          /* 订阅变了，PRO 徽标跟着变 */
        if (CURRENT_GAME) {
          var owned = hasLic(CURRENT_GAME);
          document.getElementById('subSection').hidden = !owned;
          document.getElementById('injectSection').hidden = !owned;
          if (owned) updateSubDisplay(licOf(CURRENT_GAME));
          renderDetailHeroButtons(CURRENT_GAME);
        }
      } catch (err) {}
    }
    else if (msg === 'PAUSE_DENIED') {
      PAUSE_PENDING = {};
      /* 宿主检测到游戏进程在跑：视为已启动，暂停按钮从此刻起保持禁用 */
      if (CURRENT_GAME) { LAUNCHED[CURRENT_GAME] = true; refreshPauseUi(CURRENT_GAME); }
      toast(uiT('pauseBlocked'), 'err', 3500);
    }
    else if (msg === 'PAUSE_ERR') {
      PAUSE_PENDING = {};
      if (CURRENT_GAME) refreshPauseUi(CURRENT_GAME);
      toast(uiT('errNet'), 'err', 3000);
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('PAUSE_ERR:') === 0) {
      PAUSE_PENDING = {};
      if (CURRENT_GAME) refreshPauseUi(CURRENT_GAME);
      toast(msg.slice(10) || uiT('errNet'), 'err', 3500);
    }
    else if (msg === 'REQ_OK') {
      reqSetBusy(false); closeGameReq();
      toast(uiT('reqOk'), 'ok', 3000);
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('REQ_ERR:') === 0) {
      reqSetBusy(false);
      var rc = msg.slice(8);
      if (rc === 'GAME') { document.getElementById('reqGame').classList.add('is-err'); toast(uiT('reqErrGame'), 'err', 2500); }
      else if (rc === 'RATE') { toast(uiT('reqErrRate'), 'err', 3000); }
      else if (rc === 'AUTH') { toast(uiT('errAuth'), 'err', 3000); }
      else if (rc.indexOf('TEXT:') === 0) { toast(rc.slice(5) || uiT('accErrFail'), 'err', 3500); }
      else { toast(uiT('errNet'), 'err', 3000); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('TASK_BEGIN:') === 0) {
      var bg = msg.slice(11);
      if (bg && GAMES[bg]) { sbTaskShow(bg, uiT('injecting')); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('TASK_PROG:') === 0) {
      var pp = msg.slice(10).split(':');
      var pv = parseInt(pp[1], 10);
      if (isFinite(pv)) { injectOnProgress(pp[0], pv); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('TASK_STAGE:') === 0) {
      var ss2 = msg.slice(11).split(':');
      if (ss2[1] === 'extract') { sbTaskStage(uiT('extracting')); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('INJECT_OK:') === 0) {
      toast(uiT('injectOk'), 'ok');
      injectOnOk(msg.slice(10));
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('RUNS:') === 0) {
      /* 启动成功后宿主把新的运行次数发回来，就地更新，不用重开程序 */
      var rParts = msg.slice(5).split('|');
      var rCode = rParts[0];
      if (GAMES[rCode]) {
        GAMES[rCode].runs = parseInt(rParts[1], 10) || 0;
        GAMES[rCode].runsWeek = parseInt(rParts[2], 10) || 0;
      }
      if (typeof gpopRefreshStats === 'function') gpopRefreshStats(rCode);
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('GAMESUPD:') === 0) {
      /* 宿主后台拉到新的 games.txt：GAMESUPD:<games json>\n<顺序 csv>，就地换上 */
      var gBody = msg.slice(9);
      var nl = gBody.indexOf('\n');
      var gJson = (nl >= 0) ? gBody.slice(0, nl) : gBody;
      var gOrder = (nl >= 0) ? gBody.slice(nl + 1) : '';
      if (typeof applyGamesUpdate === 'function') applyGamesUpdate(gJson, gOrder);
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('INJECT_ERR:') === 0) {
      var parts = msg.split(':');
      var reason = '';
      if (parts.length > 2) reason = parts.slice(2).join(':');
      var retryG = CURRENT_GAME;
      if (CURRENT_GAME) LAUNCHING[CURRENT_GAME] = false;
      toast(uiT('injectFail') + uiErrText(reason), 'err', 7000, retryG ? {action:{label:uiT('toastRetry'), run:function(){
        var need = CURRENT_GAME !== retryG;
        if (need && typeof openDetail === 'function') openDetail(retryG);
        setTimeout(function(){ if (CURRENT_GAME === retryG) doInject(); }, need ? 360 : 0);
      }}} : null);
      cancelInject();
      sbTaskFinish('err', uiT('injectFail') + uiErrText(reason), 7000);
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('RENEW_OK:') === 0) {
      if (typeof uiRenewResult === 'function') {
        uiRenewResult(true, msg.slice(9));
      }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('RENEW_ERR:') === 0) {
      if (typeof uiRenewResult === 'function') {
        uiRenewResult(false, msg.slice(10));
      }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('REVIEWS_RAW:') === 0) {
      /* 宿主把网站返回的原文 JSON 直接转过来，这里自己 parse */
      try {
        var rv = JSON.parse(msg.slice(12));
        REVIEWS = (rv && rv.reviews) || [];
      } catch (err) { REVIEWS = []; }
      REV_LIMIT = REV_FIRST;        /* 新数据回来：回到首屏 3 条 */
      renderReviews();
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('REVIEWS_ERR:') === 0) {
      REVIEWS = [];
      var revBox = document.getElementById('revList');
      var revEmpty = document.getElementById('revEmpty');
      if (revBox) revBox.innerHTML = '';
      if (revEmpty) { revEmpty.textContent = uiT('revErrLoad'); revEmpty.hidden = false; }
    }
    else if (msg === 'REVIEW_OK') {
      revSetBusy(false);
      closeReviewModal();
      toast(uiT('revOk'), 'ok', 3500);
      REVIEWS = null;
      wv('REVIEWS');          /* 立刻再拉一次（新评价要审核过后才会出现） */
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('REVIEW_ERR:') === 0) {
      revSetBusy(false);
      var rc = msg.slice(11);
      if (rc === 'SHORT')        { toast(uiT('revErrShort'), 'err', 2500); }
      else if (rc === 'PENDING') { toast(uiT('revPending'), 'err', 3500); }
      else if (rc === 'AUTH')    { toast(uiT('errAuth'), 'err', 3000); }
      else if (rc.indexOf('TEXT:') === 0) { toast(rc.slice(5) || uiT('accErrFail'), 'err', 3500); }
      else                       { toast(uiT('errNet'), 'err', 3000); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('MYGROUP:') === 0) {
      /* 网站回传的实时组：正常用户 = release，管理员 = admin */
      var gp = msg.slice(8).split('|');
      if (gp[0]) MY_GROUP = gp[0];
      if (gp[1]) MY_ROLE  = gp[1];
      updateProfileGroup();
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('WHEEL_RAW:') === 0) {
      var wrest = msg.slice(10), wcol = wrest.indexOf(':');
      wheelOnRaw(wcol >= 0 ? wrest.slice(0, wcol) : wrest, wcol >= 0 ? wrest.slice(wcol + 1) : '');
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('ADMIN_RAW:') === 0) {
      var arest  = msg.slice(10);
      var acolon = arest.indexOf(':');
      var aact   = (acolon >= 0) ? arest.slice(0, acolon) : arest;
      var abody  = (acolon >= 0) ? arest.slice(acolon + 1) : '';
      var ajson = null, aok = false, amsg = '';
      try {
        ajson = JSON.parse(abody);
        aok   = !!(ajson && ajson.ok);
        amsg  = (ajson && (ajson.msg || ajson.error)) || '';
      } catch (e) {}

      /* 列表类请求：成功就落数据重绘；失败把错误显示在列表区域里，
         **绝不再自动重试**（否则失败 → 重试 → 又失败，会把界面打成死循环） */
      if (aact === 'users') {
        ADMIN_ERR = aok ? '' : (amsg || uiT('adminFailed'));
        if (aok) { ADMIN_USERS = (ajson && ajson.users) || []; }
        renderAdminUsers();
      } else if (aact === 'tickets') {
        ADMIN_ERR = aok ? '' : (amsg || uiT('adminFailed'));
        if (aok) { ADMIN_TICKETS = (ajson && ajson.tickets) || []; }
        renderAdminTickets();
      } else if (!aok) {
        toast(amsg || uiT('adminFailed'), 'err', 3500);
      } else {
        if (amsg) { toast(amsg, 'ok', 2500); }
        /* 只有「操作成功」才回头刷新列表 */
        if (aact.indexOf('ticket') === 0) { wv('ADMIN:tickets'); wv('ADMIN:users'); }
        else { wv('ADMIN:users'); }
      }
    }
    else if (msg === 'SUBS_ERR') {
      /* 网站那边订阅拉不到（比如新版 api/auth.php 还没上传）——只提醒一次 */
      if (!window.__subsWarned) {
        window.__subsWarned = 1;
        toast(uiT('subsErr'), 'err', 5000);
      }
    }
  });

  var INBOX = null;          /* null = 还没拉到；[] = 没有任何请求 */
  var INBOX_LAST = -1;       /* 上一次看到的未读数（-1 = 还没拉过） */
    if (typeof ANNOUNCEMENTS === 'undefined') { var ANNOUNCEMENTS = []; }
  function inboxEl(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  function inboxIsOpen(){
    var m = inboxEl('inboxModal');
    return !!m && m.classList.contains('open');
  }
  function inboxSetBadge(n){
    var b = inboxEl('tbInboxBadge');
    if (!b) return;
    if (n > 0) { b.textContent = n > 9 ? '9+' : String(n); b.hidden = false; }
    else { b.hidden = true; }
  }
  function inboxRender(){
    var list = inboxEl('inboxList'), empty = inboxEl('inboxEmpty');
    if (!list || !empty) return;
    if (INBOX === null || !INBOX.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '';
      empty.textContent = uiT(INBOX === null ? 'inboxLoading' : 'inboxEmpty');
      empty.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    empty.hidden = true;
    var h = '';
    INBOX.forEach(function(r){
      var st = /^(pending|replied|added|declined)$/.test(r.status) ? r.status : 'pending';
      h += '<div class="ib-item">'
        + '<div class="ib-head"><span class="ib-game">' + uiEsc(r.game) + '</span>'
        + '<span class="ib-st ib-st-' + st + '">'
        + uiEsc(uiT('inboxSt' + st.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + st.slice(1))) + '</span></div>'
        + '<div class="ib-meta">' + uiEsc(uiT('inboxYouAsked')) + ' · ' + uiEsc(r.date) + '</div>';
      var rp = r.replies || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < rp.length; i++) {
        h += '<div class="ib-reply' + (rp[i].unread ? ' is-new' : '') + '">'
          + '<div class="ib-reply-meta">' + uiEsc(rp[i].admin) + ' · ' + uiEsc(rp[i].date)
          + (rp[i].unread ? '<b>' + uiEsc(uiT('inboxNew')) + '</b>' : '') + '</div>'
          + '<div class="ib-reply-body">' + uiEsc(rp[i].body) + '</div></div>';
      }
      if (!rp.length) { h += '<div class="ib-wait">' + uiEsc(uiT('inboxWaiting')) + '</div>'; }
      h += '</div>';
    });
    list.innerHTML = h;
  }
  function openInbox(){
    var m = inboxEl('inboxModal');
    if (!m) return;
    m.classList.add('open');
    inboxRender();
    wv('INBOX');
  }
  function closeInbox(){
    var m = inboxEl('inboxModal');
    if (m) m.classList.remove('open');
  }
  function inboxNewRequest(){
    closeInbox();
    openGameReq();
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeInbox();
  });
  window.chrome.webview.addEventListener('message', function(e){
    var msg = e.data;
    if (typeof msg !== 'string') return;

    if (msg.indexOf('ANNOUNCEMENTS_RAW:') === 0) {
      annClearWait();
      try {
        var annList = JSON.parse(msg.slice(18));
        if (annList && !Array.isArray(annList)) { annList = annList.announcements; }   /* 网站回 {ok:true, announcements:[...]} */
        if (Array.isArray(annList)) {
          ANNOUNCEMENTS = annList.map(function(a){
            return {
              id:    String(a.ann_key || a.id || ''),
              title: String(a.title || ''),
              text:  String(a.text || a.body || ''),
              date:  String(a.ann_date || a.date || '').slice(0, 10)
            };
          });
          ANN_STATE = 'ok';
          annRenderList();
          annPaintBadge();
        } else { ANN_STATE = 'err:FORMAT'; annRenderList(); }
      } catch (e) { ANN_STATE = 'err:PARSE'; annRenderList(); }
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('ANNOUNCEMENTS_ERR:') === 0) {
      annClearWait();
      ANN_STATE = 'err:' + msg.slice(18);
      annRenderList();
    }
    else if (msg.indexOf('INBOX_RAW:') === 0) {
      var d = null;
      try { d = JSON.parse(msg.slice(10)); } catch (err) {}
      if (!d || !d.ok) return;
      INBOX = d.requests || [];
      var un = d.unread | 0;
      if (inboxIsOpen()) {
        inboxRender();                         /* 这一次还带着「新」标记，让你看清哪些是新回复 */
        if (un > 0) { wv('INBOX_READ'); }      /* 同时告诉网站已读 */
        INBOX_LAST = 0; inboxSetBadge(0);
      } else {
        if (un > Math.max(INBOX_LAST, 0)) { toast(uiT('inboxNewReply'), 'info', 4500); }
        INBOX_LAST = un; inboxSetBadge(un);
      }
    }
    else if (msg === 'REQ_OK') {
      setTimeout(function(){ wv('INBOX'); }, 400);     /* 刚提交的请求马上出现在信息里 */
    }
  });
  setInterval(function(){ if (!document.hidden) { wv('INBOX'); wv('ANNOUNCEMENTS'); annWait(); } }, 60000);
  wv('INBOX');
  wv('ANNOUNCEMENTS');   /* 向宿主要公告列表；宿主回 ANNOUNCEMENTS_RAW:[...] */
  annWait();             /* 8 秒没回包就把「Loading…」换成超时提示，别一直转 */

  /* ════════ Announcements：顶部图标 + 弹窗 ════════
     公告数据就在这个数组里维护；有新的（id 没在 localStorage 里）时图标跳动 + 小红点。
     打开弹窗即视为已读。 */
  var ANN_STATE = 'wait';   /* wait = 还没收到宿主回复；ok；err:<代码> */
  var ANN_TIMER = null;
  var ANN_SEEN_KEY = 'starline.ann.seen';
  var ANN_SEEN = (function(){
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(ANN_SEEN_KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    } catch (e) { return []; }
  })();
  function annIsUnread(a){ return ANN_SEEN.indexOf(a.id) < 0; }
  /* 等宿主回包：8 秒没动静就把状态从 wait 改成 err:TIMEOUT（避免界面一直显示 Loading…） */
  function annWait(){
    ANN_STATE = 'wait';
    if (ANN_TIMER) { clearTimeout(ANN_TIMER); }
    ANN_TIMER = setTimeout(function(){
      if (ANN_STATE === 'wait') { ANN_STATE = 'err:TIMEOUT'; annRenderList(); }
    }, 8000);
  }
  function annClearWait(){
    if (ANN_TIMER) { clearTimeout(ANN_TIMER); ANN_TIMER = null; }
  }
  function annUnreadCount(){
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < ANNOUNCEMENTS.length; i++) { if (annIsUnread(ANNOUNCEMENTS[i])) { n++; } }
    return n;
  }
  function annSaveSeen(){
    try { localStorage.setItem(ANN_SEEN_KEY, JSON.stringify(ANN_SEEN)); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function annPaintBadge(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('tbAnn');
    var dot = document.getElementById('tbAnnDot');
    var un  = annUnreadCount();
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('bounce', un > 0);
    if (dot) dot.hidden = !(un > 0);
  }
  function annRenderList(){
    var box = document.getElementById('annList');
    if (!box) return;
    if (!ANNOUNCEMENTS.length) {
      var emptyTxt = uiT('annEmpty');
      if (ANN_STATE === 'wait') { emptyTxt = 'Loading…'; }
      else if (ANN_STATE.indexOf('err:') === 0) { emptyTxt = 'Failed to load announcements (' + ANN_STATE.slice(4) + ')'; }
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="ann-item"><div class="ann-item-body">'
        + '<div class="ann-item-txt">' + uiEsc(emptyTxt) + '</div></div></div>';
      return;
    }
    var html = '';
    ANNOUNCEMENTS.forEach(function(a){
      var isNew = annIsUnread(a);
      html += '<div class="ann-item">'
        +   '<div class="ann-item-ico">'
        +     '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l18-8-8 18-2-8-8-2z"/></svg>'
        +   '</div>'
        +   '<div class="ann-item-body">'
        +     '<div class="ann-item-top">'
        +       '<span class="ann-item-title">' + uiEsc(a.title || '') + '</span>'
        +       (isNew ? '<span class="ann-item-new">' + uiEsc(uiT('annNew')) + '</span>' : '')
        +     '</div>'
        +     '<div class="ann-item-txt">' + uiEsc(a.text || '') + '</div>'
        +     '<div class="ann-item-date">' + uiEsc(a.date || '') + '</div>'
        +   '</div>'
        + '</div>';
    });
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }
  /* 定位：贴在图标正下方，箭头对准图标中心 */
  function annPlace(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('tbAnn');
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    var arr = document.getElementById('annArrow');
    if (!btn || !pop) return;
    var r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    var pw = pop.offsetWidth || 340;
    var ph = pop.offsetHeight || 260;
    var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
    var x = r.left + r.width / 2 - pw / 2;
    if (x + pw > vw - 10) x = vw - pw - 10;
    if (x < 10) x = 10;
    var y = r.bottom + 10;
    if (y + ph > vh - 10) { y = Math.max(10, r.top - ph - 10); }   /* 空间不够就翻到上面 */
    pop.style.left = Math.round(x) + 'px';
    pop.style.top  = Math.round(y) + 'px';
    if (arr) arr.style.left = Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2 - x) + 'px';
  }
  function openAnn(ev){
    if (ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); }
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    if (!pop) return;
    annRenderList();
    annWait();
    wv('ANNOUNCEMENTS');                  /* 打开时再拉一次，保证看到最新公告 */
    pop.hidden = false;
    void pop.offsetWidth;                 /* 强制 reflow，让 transition 生效 */
    pop.classList.add('show');
    annPlace();
    /* 打开即视为已读：图标停止跳动、小红点消失 */
    ANNOUNCEMENTS.forEach(function(a){ if (annIsUnread(a)) { ANN_SEEN.push(a.id); } });
    annSaveSeen();
    setTimeout(annPaintBadge, 200);
  }
  function closeAnn(ev){
    if (ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); }
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    if (!pop) return;
    pop.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function(){ if (!pop.classList.contains('show')) { pop.hidden = true; } }, 220);
  }
  function toggleAnn(ev){
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    if (!pop) return;
    if (pop.hidden || !pop.classList.contains('show')) { openAnn(ev); }
    else { closeAnn(ev); }
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    if (!pop || pop.hidden) return;
    var t = e.target;
    if (t && t.closest && (t.closest('#annPop') || t.closest('#tbAnn'))) return;
    closeAnn();
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeAnn(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    var pop = document.getElementById('annPop');
    if (pop && pop.classList.contains('show')) { annPlace(); }
  });

  /* 首次进页面初始化图标状态（有未读 → 跳动 + 小红点） */
  annPaintBadge();


  window.onRenewSuccess = function(){
    wv('GET_LICENSES');
  };

  applyUser();
  updateProfileGroup();       /* 个人资料里的实时组 + 管理员左边 tab */
  applyDPI(USER.dpi || 100);
  renderHero();
  if (typeof gpopBind === 'function') gpopBind();      /* 卡片悬停预览 / 列表右侧详情块 */
  renderGrid();
  renderQuickplay();
  renderDownloads();
  renderGenreBtn();
  renderGenrePop();
  startHeroTimer();
  if (typeof uiInit === 'function') uiInit();
  renderGenreBtn();     /* uiInit 里的 i18n 会重刷按钮文字，这里再校正一次 */
  wv('GET_LICENSES');
  wv('SYNC_SUBS');      /* 登录后拉一次服务端订阅，管理员冻结/删除会立刻反映到本地 */
  wv('MYINFO');         /* 顺手刷新一次「实时组」 */
  if (window.logoFx) logoFx.consumeLoginIntro();   /* 登录成功：3D Logo 飞到侧栏 */
  else document.body.classList.remove('logo-intro');
</script>

  var ACT=[['settings','skActSettings','<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .3 1.8l.1.1a2 2 0 1 1-2.8 2.8l-.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.8-.3 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1 1.5V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.1-1.5 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.8.3l-.1.1a2 2 0 1 1-2.8-2.8l.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .3-1.8 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.5-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.5-1.1 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.3-1.8l-.1-.1a2 2 0 1 1 2.8-2.8l.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.8.3H9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1-1.5V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1 1.5 1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.8-.3l.1-.1a2 2 0 1 1 2.8 2.8l-.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.3 1.8V9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.5 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.5 1z"/>'],
    ['log','skActLog','<path d="M12 8v4l3 2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/>'],
    ['status','skActStatus','<path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/>'],
    ['renew','skActRenew','<path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-3-6.7L21 8"/><path d="M21 3v5h-5"/>'],
    ['world','skActWorld','<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c2.5 2.5 3.7 5.6 3.7 9s-1.200 6.500-3.700 9c-2.500-2.500-3.700-5.600-3.700-9S9.500 5.500 12 3z"/>'],
    ['lang','skActLang','<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18"/><path d="M12 3a14 14 0 0 1 0 18M12 3a14 14 0 0 0 0 18"/>'],
    ['profile','skActProfile','<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/>'],
    ['keys','skActKeys','<rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M6 10h.01M10 10h.01M14 10h.01M18 10h.01M7 14h10"/>']];
  function actionsHtml(){
    var h='<div class="sk-sec"><div class="sk-h"><span>'+esc(uiT('skActions'))+'</span></div>';
    ACT.forEach(function(a){h+='<button type="button" class="sk-item sk-actn" data-act="'+a[0]+'" data-lbl="'+esc(uiT(a[1]).toLowerCase())+'"><i class="sk-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">'+a[2]+'</svg></i><span class="sk-t">'+esc(uiT(a[1]))+'</span>'+CHEV+'</button>';});
    return h+'</div>';
  }
  function chipsHtml(){
    var S=[['all','skAll'],['games','skScopeGames'],['faq','skScopeFaq'],['msgs','skScopeMsgs'],['actions','skScopeActions']];
    return '<div class="sk-chips" id="skChips">'+S.map(function(p){return '<button type="button" class="sk-chip'+(scope===p[0]?' on':'')+'" data-scope="'+p[0]+'">'+esc(uiT(p[1]))+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function recentHtml(){
    if(!recent.length)return '';
    return '<div class="sk-sec" data-sec="recent" id="skRecent"><div class="sk-h"><span>'+esc(uiT('skRecent'))+'</span><b><a href="#" class="sk-clr" data-clr="1">'+esc(uiT('skClear'))+'</a></b></div>'
      +recent.map(function(q){return '<button type="button" class="sk-item sk-rec" data-recent="'+esc(q)+'"><i class="sk-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></i><span class="sk-t">'+esc(q)+'</span></button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function tag(h,name){return h.replace('<div class="sk-sec','<div data-sec="'+name+'" class="sk-sec');}
  function build(){scroll.innerHTML=chipsHtml()+recentHtml()+tag(themeHtml(),'actions')+tag(actionsHtml(),'actions')+tag(msgsHtml(),'msgs')+tag(faqHtml(),'faq')+tag(gamesHtml(),'games');}

  /* 搜索框里有字时，弹窗里的游戏列表同步过滤；清空就是全部游戏 */
  function filter(){
    var q=String(input.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),n=0;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('[data-sec]'),function(sec){
      var nm=sec.getAttribute('data-sec'),show=(scope==='all')||(scope===nm);
      if(nm==='recent')show=(scope==='all')&&!q;
      sec.style.display=show?'':'none';
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('.sk-actn'),function(b){b.hidden=!!q&&b.getAttribute('data-lbl').indexOf(q)<0;});
    var th=$('skTheme');if(th)th.hidden=!!q&&String(uiT('toggleTheme')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('.sk-faq'),function(b){b.hidden=!!q&&b.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0;});
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('.sk-grp'),function(g){g.hidden=!!q&&(g.getAttribute('data-k')||'').split('|')[0].toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0;});
    var list=$('skGames');
    if(list)Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.children,function(b){
      var id=b.getAttribute('data-game'),m=GAMES[id]||{};
      var hit=!q||String(m.title||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0
                 ||String(m.dev||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0
                 ||String(id).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
      b.hidden=!hit;if(hit)n++;
    });
    var cnt=$('skCount');if(cnt)cnt.textContent=n;
    var none=$('skNone');if(none)none.hidden=n>0;
    /* 有搜索词时，没有任何命中的区块整块收起 */
    if(q)['actions','msgs','faq'].forEach(function(nm){
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('[data-sec="'+nm+'"]'),function(sec){
        if(sec.style.display==='none')return;
        var vis=0;Array.prototype.forEach.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.sk-item'),function(it){if(!it.hidden&&!it.closest('[hidden]'))vis++;});
        if(!vis)sec.style.display='none';
      });
    });
  }

  /* ── 消息详情（右侧带箭头的小弹窗） ── */
  function chip(st){return '<span class="sk-st sk-st-'+st+'">'+esc(stText(st))+'</span>';}
  function replyBlock(p){
    return '<div class="sk-rp'+(p.unread?' is-new':'')+'"><div class="sk-dm">'+esc(p.admin)+' · '+esc(p.date)
      +(p.unread?'<b class="sk-newtag">'+esc(uiT('inboxNew'))+'</b>':'')+'</div><div class="sk-db">'+esc(p.body)+'</div></div>';
  }
  function head(r){return '<div class="sk-dh"><span class="sk-dt">'+esc(r.game)+'</span>'+chip(stOf(r))+'</div>';}
  function reqDetail(r){
    var rp=r.replies||[],h=head(r)+'<div class="sk-dm">'+esc(uiT('inboxYouAsked'))+' · '+esc(r.date)+'</div>';
    if(!rp.length)h+='<div class="sk-db sk-dim">'+esc(uiT('inboxWaiting'))+'</div>';
    rp.forEach(function(p){h+=replyBlock(p);});
    return h;
  }
  function repDetail(r,p){return head(r)+replyBlock(p);}

  function placeDet(){
    if(!activeRow||det.hidden)return;
    var sr=scroll.getBoundingClientRect(),rr=activeRow.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(sr.height>0&&(rr.bottom<sr.top+4||rr.top>sr.bottom-4)){hideDet();return;}
    var pr=pop.getBoundingClientRect(),vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth,vh=document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    var w=det.offsetWidth,h=det.offsetHeight,gap=14;
    var roomR=vw-8-(pr.right+gap),roomL=pr.left-gap-8;
    var flip=roomR<w&&roomL>roomR;
    var left=flip?pr.left-gap-w:pr.right+gap;
    left=Math.max(8,Math.min(left,vw-8-w));
    var cy=rr.top+rr.height/2;
    var top=Math.max(8,Math.min(cy-26,vh-8-h));
    var ay=Math.max(14,Math.min(cy-top-6,h-26));
    det.style.left=Math.round(left)+'px';det.style.top=Math.round(top)+'px';
    det.style.setProperty('--sk-ay',Math.round(ay)+'px');
    det.classList.toggle('flip',flip);
  }
  function showDet(row,html){
    if(activeRow)activeRow.classList.remove('on');
    activeRow=row;row.classList.add('on');
    detBody.innerHTML=html;detBody.scrollTop=0;
    det.style.animation='none';det.hidden=false;void det.offsetWidth;det.style.animation='';
    placeDet();
  }
  function hideDet(){
    det.hidden=true;
    if(activeRow){activeRow.classList.remove('on');activeRow=null;}
  }

  /* ── 弹窗定位：fixed，箭头对准 Ctrl+K 按钮中心 ── */
  function place(){
    var br=kbd.getBoundingClientRect(),r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
    var vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    var w=Math.min(440,vw-24);
    var left=Math.max(12,Math.min(r.right-w,vw-12-w));
    pop.style.width=w+'px';pop.style.left=Math.round(left)+'px';pop.style.top=Math.round(r.bottom+14)+'px';
    var ar=Math.max(16,Math.min(w-30,Math.round(left+w-(br.left+br.width/2)-6)));
    pop.style.setProperty('--sk-ar',ar+'px');
  }

  function blocked(){
    if(!box.offsetParent)return true;
    if(document.querySelector('.ui-view.open')||document.querySelector('.req-modal.open'))return true;
    var f=$('faqPop');if(f&&!f.hidden)return true;
    return false;
  }

  function runAct(a){
    try{
      if(a==='settings'&&typeof uiOpenSettings==='function')uiOpenSettings();
      else if(a==='log'&&typeof uiOpenChangelog==='function')uiOpenChangelog();
      else if(a==='status'&&window.stOpen)window.stOpen();
      else if(a==='renew'&&typeof uiOpenRenew==='function')uiOpenRenew();
      else if(a==='world'){var w=$('worldMapOpen');if(w)w.click();}
      else if(a==='lang'){var l=$('tbLang');if(l)l.click();}
      else if(a==='profile'&&typeof showProfile==='function')showProfile();
      else if(a==='keys'&&window.hkOpen)window.hkOpen();
    }catch(err){}
  }
  function open(){
    if(blocked())return;
    labels();build();filter();place();
    pop.hidden=false;kbd.classList.add('open');kbd.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    scroll.scrollTop=0;
    if(typeof wv==='function'){try{wv('INBOX');}catch(e){}}   /* 顺手刷新一下消息 */
    try{input.focus();}catch(e){}
  }
  function close(){
    hideDet();
    if(pop.hidden)return;
    pop.hidden=true;kbd.classList.remove('open');kbd.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }
  window.skOpen=open;
  /* Esc：先收消息详情，再收主弹窗 */
  window.skClose=function(){if(!det.hidden){hideDet();return;}close();};

  function refreshTheme(){
    var b=$('skTheme');if(!b)return;
    var t=theme();
    b.querySelector('.sk-ic').innerHTML=(t==='light'?SUN:MOON);
    b.querySelector('.sk-val').textContent=uiT(t==='light'?'lightTheme':'darkTheme');
  }
  function refreshMsgs(){
    var sec=$('skMsgSec');if(!sec||pop.hidden)return;
    var tmp=document.createElement('div');tmp.innerHTML=msgsHtml();
    sec.parentNode.replaceChild(tmp.firstChild,sec);hideDet();
  }

  kbd.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();if(pop.hidden)open();else close();});

  scroll.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var cp=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.sk-chip'):null;
    if(cp){scope=cp.getAttribute('data-scope');Array.prototype.forEach.call(scroll.querySelectorAll('.sk-chip'),function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x===cp);});filter();hideDet();scroll.scrollTop=0;return;}
    var cl=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.sk-clr'):null;
    if(cl){e.preventDefault();recent=[];try{localStorage.removeItem(RK);}catch(_){}var rs=$('skRecent');if(rs)rs.parentNode.removeChild(rs);return;}
    var rc=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.sk-rec'):null;
    if(rc){input.value=rc.getAttribute('data-recent');try{input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}catch(_){}filter();try{input.focus();}catch(_){}return;}
    var fb=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.sk-foldbtn'):null;
    if(fb){
      var sec=fb.parentNode;sec.classList.toggle('sk-fold-on');
      secFolded=sec.classList.contains('sk-fold-on');
      fb.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!secFolded));
      hideDet();return;
    }
    var b=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.sk-item'):null;if(!b)return;
    var act=b.getAttribute('data-act');
    if(act==='theme'){
      if(typeof uiToggleTheme==='function')uiToggleTheme();
      refreshTheme();setTimeout(refreshTheme,80);setTimeout(refreshTheme,300);
      return;
    }
    if(act&&act!=='theme'){saveRecent();close();runAct(act);return;}
    var ri=b.getAttribute('data-req');
    if(ri!==null){
      var r=inbox()[parseInt(ri,10)];if(!r)return;
      var rep=b.getAttribute('data-rep');
      if(rep===null){
        var g=b.parentNode;g.classList.toggle('open');
        openReq[g.getAttribute('data-k')]=g.classList.contains('open');
        if(g.classList.contains('open'))showDet(b,reqDetail(r));else hideDet();
      }else{
        var p=(r.replies||[])[parseInt(rep,10)];if(!p)return;
        showDet(b,repDetail(r,p));
      }
      return;
    }
    var fi=b.getAttribute('data-faq'),gid=b.getAttribute('data-game');
    saveRecent();close();
    if(fi!==null&&typeof window.faqAsk==='function'){window.faqAsk(parseInt(fi,10));}
    else if(gid&&GAMES[gid]){openDetail(gid);}
  });
  scroll.addEventListener('scroll',placeDet);

  input.addEventListener('input',function(){if(!pop.hidden)filter();});
  /* 弹窗开着且搜索框有字：回车 = 执行第一个可见结果（操作 → FAQ → 游戏） */
  input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(pop.hidden||e.key!=='Enter'||!String(input.value||'').trim())return;
    var items=Array.prototype.filter.call(pop.querySelectorAll('.sk-item'),function(b){
      return !b.hidden&&!b.closest('[hidden]')&&b.offsetParent&&!b.classList.contains('sk-req')&&!b.classList.contains('sk-kid')&&!b.classList.contains('sk-rec')&&b.id!=='skTheme';
    });
    if(!items.length)return;e.preventDefault();items[0].click();
  });

  document.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
    if(pop.hidden)return;
    var t=e.target;
    if(box.contains(t)||pop.contains(t)||det.contains(t))return;
    close();
  },true);

  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    /* Ctrl+K / ⌘K：开关弹窗 */
    if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&!e.altKey&&!e.shiftKey&&(e.key==='k'||e.key==='K')){
      if(blocked()&&pop.hidden)return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if(pop.hidden)open();else close();
      return;
    }
    /* 弹窗开着时：上下键在条目间移动，回车触发 */
    if(pop.hidden)return;
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){
      var items=Array.prototype.filter.call(pop.querySelectorAll('.sk-item'),function(b){return !b.hidden&&b.offsetParent;});
      if(!items.length)return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var i=items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
      i=(e.key==='ArrowDown')?(i+1)%items.length:(i<=0?items.length-1:i-1);
      items[i].focus();
      if(items[i].scrollIntoView)items[i].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(!pop.hidden){place();placeDet();}});

  /* 宿主推来新的收件箱数据时，弹窗开着就刷新消息树 */
  try{
    if(window.chrome&&window.chrome.webview){
      window.chrome.webview.addEventListener('message',function(ev){
        var m=ev.data;
        if(typeof m==='string'&&m.indexOf('INBOX_RAW:')===0&&!pop.hidden)setTimeout(refreshMsgs,0);
      });
    }
  }catch(err){}

  /* 语言切换时刷新文案 */
  var prevLang=window.onUiLangChanged;
  window.onUiLangChanged=function(){
    var r=typeof prevLang==='function'?prevLang.apply(this,arguments):undefined;
    labels();
    if(!pop.hidden){var st=scroll.scrollTop;hideDet();build();filter();scroll.scrollTop=st;}
    return r;
  };
  labels();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ═══════ 顶栏语言按钮：国旗 → 点击在下方弹出带箭头的语言列表（国旗 · 5px · 语言名称） ═══════ */
(function(){
  var btn=document.getElementById('tbLang'),pop=document.getElementById('lgPop');
  if(!btn||!pop||typeof UI_LANGS==='undefined')return;
  document.body.appendChild(pop);
  var CK='<svg class="lg-ck" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>';
  var PEN='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg>';
  var PLUS='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>';

  function cur(){return (typeof uiState!=='undefined'&&uiState.lang)||document.documentElement.lang||'en';}
  function find(code){for(var i=0;i<UI_LANGS.length;i++)if(UI_LANGS[i].code===code)return UI_LANGS[i];return null;}
  function flag(l){return '<span class="lg-flag">'+uiFlagSvg(l.flag)+'</span>';}

  function paintBtn(){
    var l=find(cur())||UI_LANGS[0];
    btn.innerHTML=flag(l);
    try{btn.title=uiT('language');}catch(e){}
  }
  function render(){
    var c=cur(),h='';
    UI_LANGS.forEach(function(l){
      h+='<button type="button" role="option" class="lg-item'+(l.code===c?' active':'')+'" data-lang="'+l.code+'" lang="'+l.code+'" aria-selected="'+(l.code===c)+'">'
        +flag(l)+'<span class="lg-name">'+uiEsc(l.native)+'</span>'
        +(l.custom?'<span class="lg-edit" role="button" data-edit="'+l.code+'" title="'+uiEsc(uiT('ctEdit'))+'">'+PEN+'</span>':'')
        +CK+'</button>';
    });
    h+='<div class="lg-sep"></div><button type="button" class="lg-item lg-add" data-add="1"><span class="lg-ico">'+PLUS+'</span><span class="lg-name">'+uiEsc(uiT('ctNew'))+'</span></button>';
    pop.innerHTML=h;
  }
  /* 箭头对准国旗按钮中心，弹窗在按钮正下方 */
  function place(){
    var br=btn.getBoundingClientRect(),vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    var w=pop.offsetWidth,cx=br.left+br.width/2;
    var left=Math.max(12,Math.min(Math.round(cx-w/2),vw-12-w));
    pop.style.left=left+'px';pop.style.top=Math.round(br.bottom+12)+'px';
    pop.style.setProperty('--lg-ar',Math.max(14,Math.min(w-26,Math.round(cx-left-6)))+'px');
  }
  function open(){
    render();pop.hidden=false;place();
    btn.classList.add('open');btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  }
  function close(){
    if(pop.hidden)return;
    pop.hidden=true;btn.classList.remove('open');btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }
  window.lgClose=close;

  btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();if(pop.hidden)open();else close();});
  pop.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var ed=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.lg-edit'):null;
    if(ed){close();if(window.uiOpenTransEditor)uiOpenTransEditor(ed.getAttribute('data-edit'));return;}
    var ad=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.lg-add'):null;
    if(ad){close();if(window.uiOpenTransEditor)uiOpenTransEditor();return;}
    var b=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.lg-item'):null;if(!b)return;
    var code=b.getAttribute('data-lang');close();
    if(code&&code!==cur()&&typeof uiSetLang==='function')uiSetLang(code);
  });
  document.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
    if(pop.hidden)return;
    var t=e.target;if(btn.contains(t)||pop.contains(t))return;
    close();
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(pop.hidden||(e.key!=='ArrowDown'&&e.key!=='ArrowUp'))return;
    var items=Array.prototype.slice.call(pop.querySelectorAll('.lg-item'));if(!items.length)return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var i=items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    i=(e.key==='ArrowDown')?(i+1)%items.length:(i<=0?items.length-1:i-1);
    items[i].focus();
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(!pop.hidden)place();});

  /* 语言变化（含设置页、宿主推送）时同步按钮上的国旗和列表选中态 */
  var prev=window.onUiLangChanged;
  window.onUiLangChanged=function(){
    var r=typeof prev==='function'?prev.apply(this,arguments):undefined;
    paintBtn();if(!pop.hidden){render();place();}
    return r;
  };
  paintBtn();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ═══════ 右下角拖拽手柄：拖动即改变 APP 窗口大小（向宿主发 RESIZE:宽x高） ═══════ */
(function(){
  if(document.getElementById('uiResizeGrip'))return;
  var g=document.createElement('div');
  g.id='uiResizeGrip';g.setAttribute('data-nodrag','');g.setAttribute('role','separator');g.setAttribute('aria-label','Resize');
  g.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12"><path d="M11 3L3 11M11 7L7 11"/></svg>';
  document.body.appendChild(g);

  var drag=null,raf=0,pend=null,last=null,root=document.documentElement;

  function flush(){
    raf=0;
    var geom=window.uiWinGeom;if(!drag||!pend||!geom)return;
    var mn=geom.min(),mx=geom.max();
    /* 窗口左上角固定：让右下角始终跟在鼠标下面（按下时的偏移保持不变） */
    var w=Math.round((pend.x+drag.ox)*drag.scale),h=Math.round((pend.y+drag.oy)*drag.scale);
    w=Math.max(mn[0],Math.min(mx[0],w));h=Math.max(mn[1],Math.min(mx[1],h));
    if(last&&last.w===w&&last.h===h)return;
    last={w:w,h:h};geom.send(w,h);
  }
  function end(){
    if(!drag)return;
    drag=null;pend=null;last=null;root.classList.remove('ui-resizing');
  }

  g.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(e.button!==0||!window.uiWinGeom)return;
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    drag={ox:window.innerWidth-e.clientX,oy:window.innerHeight-e.clientY,scale:window.uiWinGeom.scale()};
    try{g.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(err){}
    root.classList.add('ui-resizing');
  });
  g.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(!drag)return;
    pend={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
    if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(flush);
  });
  g.addEventListener('pointerup',end);
  g.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);
  g.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',end);
  /* 双击手柄：恢复为当前缩放对应的默认窗口大小 */
  g.addEventListener('dblclick',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(window.uiWinGeom)window.uiWinGeom.reset();});
})();
</script>

  function archMsg(txt,err){E.ctAMsg.className=err?'ct-err':'ct-hint';E.ctAMsg.textContent=txt||'';E.ctAMsg.title=txt||'';}
  function archJson(){
    var tpl=E.ctATpl.checked,tr={},src={};
    keys.forEach(function(k){
      if(draft[k])tr[k]=draft[k];else if(tpl)tr[k]='';
      if(tpl)src[k]=UI_T.en[k];
    });
    var o={format:'starline-lang-1',flag:E.ctFlag.value.trim().toLowerCase(),name:E.ctName.value.trim(),translations:tr};
    if(tpl)o.source=src;
    return JSON.stringify(o,null,2);
  }
  function archFill(){E.ctATa.value=archJson();archMsg('');}
  function archShow(){
    E.ctAT.textContent=t('ctArch');E.ctAS.textContent=t('ctArchSub');E.ctALTpl.textContent=t('ctTemplate');

    E.ctAImp.textContent=t('ctImportFile');E.ctAApply.textContent=t('ctApply');
    E.ctATpl.checked=false;archFill();E.ctArch.hidden=false;
  }
  function archHide(){E.ctArch.hidden=true;}
  function archCopy(){
    var txt=E.ctATa.value;
    function ok(){archMsg(t('ctCopied'));}
    function fb(){try{E.ctATa.focus();E.ctATa.select();document.execCommand('copy');ok();}catch(e){}}
    try{if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(ok,fb);return;}}catch(e){}
    fb();
  }
  /* 导出翻译档案：交给宿主弹 Windows 原生「另存为」，写完后在面板里提示保存位置；
     不再用 <a download>（那样会弹出浏览器自带的下载气泡）。老宿主没有 langSave 才退回旧做法 */
  function archDownload(){
    var nm=(E.ctName.value.trim()||E.ctFlag.value.trim()||'translation').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_');
    var host=false;
    try{host=!!(UI_CFG&&UI_CFG.langSave&&window.chrome&&window.chrome.webview);}catch(e){}
    if(host){uiSend('UI_LANGSAVE:'+nm+'.json'+String.fromCharCode(31)+E.ctATa.value);return;}
    try{
      var blob=new Blob([E.ctATa.value],{type:'application/json'});
      var a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=nm+'.json';
      document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
      setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);if(a.parentNode)a.parentNode.removeChild(a);},1500);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  /* 宿主回报：UI_LANGSAVED:ok\x1f<路径> / cancel / err */
  try{
    if(window.chrome&&window.chrome.webview){
      window.chrome.webview.addEventListener('message',function(ev){
        var m=ev.data;if(typeof m!=='string'||m.indexOf('UI_LANGSAVED:')!==0||!E.ctAMsg)return;
        var p=m.slice(13).split(String.fromCharCode(31));
        if(p[0]==='ok')archMsg(t('ctSaved')+' '+(p[1]||''));
        else if(p[0]==='err')archMsg(t('ctSaveErr'),true);
        else archMsg('');
      });
    }
  }catch(e){}
  function archApply(){
    var o;
    try{o=JSON.parse(E.ctATa.value);}catch(e){archMsg(t('ctArchErr'),true);return;}
    if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||Array.isArray(o)){archMsg(t('ctArchErr'),true);return;}
    var tr=(o.translations&&typeof o.translations==='object')?o.translations:(o.format?{}:o);
    var allowed={},nd={},cnt=0;keys.forEach(function(k){allowed[k]=1;});
    for(var k in tr){if(allowed[k]&&typeof tr[k]==='string'&&tr[k].trim()){nd[k]=tr[k];cnt++;}}
    var f=typeof o.flag==='string'?o.flag.trim().toLowerCase():'',n=typeof o.name==='string'?o.name.trim():'';
    if(!cnt&&!UI_FLAG_RE.test(f)&&!n){archMsg(t('ctArchErr'),true);return;}
    draft=nd;
    if(UI_FLAG_RE.test(f))E.ctFlag.value=f;
    if(n)E.ctName.value=n.slice(0,24);
    preview();stat();renderRows(true);archHide();
    E.ctMsg.className='ct-hint';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctArchOk')+' '+cnt;
  }

  function preview(){
    var f=E.ctFlag.value.trim().toLowerCase(),ok=UI_FLAG_RE.test(f),n=E.ctName.value.trim();
    E.ctPrev.innerHTML=ok?flagOf(f):'<span class="ct-flag ct-flag-empty"></span>';
    E.ctChip.innerHTML=(ok?flagOf(f):'<span class="ct-flag ct-flag-empty"></span>')+'<span>'+uiEsc(n||'—')+'</span>';
  }
  function stat(){
    var n=0;keys.forEach(function(k){if(draft[k])n++;});
    E.ctStat.textContent=n+' / '+keys.length+' '+t('ctDone');
  }
  function snap(){return JSON.stringify([E.ctFlag.value.trim(),E.ctName.value.trim(),draft]);}
  function dirty(){return snap()!==orig;}

  function rowHtml(k){
    var cur=uiT(k),rws=Math.max(1,Math.min(6,Math.ceil(cur.length/38)));
    return '<div class="ct-row"><div class="ct-l"><div class="ct-lt">'+uiEsc(cur)+'</div><code class="ct-k">'+uiEsc(k)+'</code></div>'
      +'<div><textarea class="ct-ta" data-k="'+uiEsc(k)+'" rows="'+rws+'" spellcheck="false" placeholder="'+uiEsc(t('ctTypePh'))+'">'+uiEsc(draft[k]||'')+'</textarea></div></div>';
  }
  function appendRows(){
    var end=Math.min(rows.length,shown+CHUNK),h='';
    for(var i=shown;i<end;i++)h+=rowHtml(rows[i]);
    shown=end;E.ctList.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',h);
  }
  function renderRows(reset){
    var q=E.ctSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase(),only=E.ctOnly.checked;
    rows=keys.filter(function(k){
      if(only&&draft[k])return false;
      if(!q)return true;
      return k.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0||uiT(k).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0||(draft[k]||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
    });
    E.ctList.innerHTML='';shown=0;if(reset)E.ctList.scrollTop=0;
    if(!rows.length){E.ctList.innerHTML='<div class="ct-none">'+uiEsc(t('ctNone'))+'</div>';return;}
    appendRows();
    /* 第一批不够撑满滚动区时继续补，保证能滚动加载 */
    while(shown<rows.length&&E.ctList.scrollHeight<=E.ctList.clientHeight+40)appendRows();
  }

  function labels(){
    E.ctTitle.textContent=t('ctTitle');E.ctArchBtn.title=t('ctArch');E.ctLFlag.textContent=t('ctFlag');E.ctLName.textContent=t('ctName');
    E.ctName.placeholder=t('ctNamePh');E.ctSearch.placeholder=t('ctSearch');E.ctLOnly.textContent=t('ctOnly');
    E.ctLCur.textContent=t('ctCurrent');E.ctLYours.textContent=t('ctYours');
    E.ctSave.textContent=t('ctSave');E.ctDel.textContent=t('ctDelete');E.ctDel.classList.remove('arm');
    E.ctMsg.className='ct-hint';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctHint');
  }

  function open(id){
    if(!root)build();
    if(typeof window.lgClose==='function')window.lgClose();
    if(typeof window.skClose==='function'){window.skClose();window.skClose();}
    var c=id?uiCustomFind(id):null;editId=c?c.id:null;
    draft={};if(c)for(var k in c.map)draft[k]=c.map[k];
    keys=Object.keys(UI_T.en).filter(function(k){return typeof UI_T.en[k]==='string'&&UI_T.en[k]!=='';});
    labels();E.ctArch.hidden=true;
    E.ctFlag.value=c?c.flag:'';E.ctName.value=c?c.native:'';
    E.ctSearch.value='';E.ctOnly.checked=false;
    E.ctDel.hidden=!c;delArm=0;escArm=0;
    preview();stat();renderRows(true);
    orig=snap();root.hidden=false;
    try{(c?E.ctName:E.ctFlag).focus();}catch(e){}
  }
  function close(force){
    if(!root||root.hidden)return;
    if(!force&&dirty()&&Date.now()-escArm>3000){
      escArm=Date.now();E.ctMsg.className='ct-err';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctDirty');return;
    }
    root.hidden=true;
  }
  function save(){
    var f=E.ctFlag.value.trim().toLowerCase(),n=E.ctName.value.trim();
    if(!UI_FLAG_RE.test(f)){E.ctMsg.className='ct-err';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctErrFlag');E.ctFlag.focus();return;}
    if(!n){E.ctMsg.className='ct-err';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctErrName');E.ctName.focus();return;}
    var saved=uiCustomUpsert({id:editId||uiCustomNewId(f),flag:f,native:n,map:draft});
    if(!saved)return;
    uiSetLang(saved.id);          /* 立刻切换到刚保存的语言，译文马上生效 */
    close(true);
  }
  window.ctRefreshLabels=function(){
    if(!root||root.hidden)return;
    try{labels();}catch(e){}
    if(E.ctArch&&!E.ctArch.hidden){
      E.ctAT.textContent=t('ctArch');E.ctAS.textContent=t('ctArchSub');E.ctALTpl.textContent=t('ctTemplate');
      E.ctABack.textContent=t('ctBack');E.ctACopy.textContent=t('ctCopy');E.ctADl.textContent=t('ctDownload');
      E.ctAImp.textContent=t('ctImportFile');E.ctAApply.textContent=t('ctApply');
      if(E.ctAMsg&&E.ctAMsg.textContent){/* 保留当前结果提示，避免切换语言时丢失操作状态 */}
    }
    try{renderRows(true);}catch(e){}
  };
  window.uiOpenTransEditor=open;
  window.uiImportTranslationFileText=function(text){
    try{
      if(!root)build();
      var o=JSON.parse(String(text||''));
      if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||Array.isArray(o))throw new Error('invalid');
      if(root.hidden)open();
      if(E.ctArch && !E.ctArch.hidden){E.ctATa.value=String(text||'');archApply();return true;}
      var tr=(o.translations&&typeof o.translations==='object')?o.translations:(o.format?{}:o);
      var next={},allowed={};keys.forEach(function(k){allowed[k]=1;});
      Object.keys(tr).forEach(function(k){if(allowed[k]&&typeof tr[k]==='string'&&tr[k].trim())next[k]=tr[k];});
      var f=typeof o.flag==='string'?o.flag.trim().toLowerCase():'',n=typeof o.name==='string'?o.name.trim():'';
      if(UI_FLAG_RE.test(f))E.ctFlag.value=f;
      if(n)E.ctName.value=n.slice(0,24);
      draft=next;E.ctArch.hidden=true;E.ctSearch.value='';E.ctOnly.checked=false;
      preview();stat();renderRows(true);orig=snap();
      E.ctMsg.className='ct-hint';E.ctMsg.textContent=t('ctArchOk')+' '+Object.keys(next).length;
      return true;
    }catch(err){return false;}
  };
  window.ctClose=function(){if(root&&E.ctArch&&!E.ctArch.hidden){archHide();return;}close(false);};
})();
</script>

  function instantiate(rec){
    var api=createAPI(rec),plugin;
    try{plugin=(new Function('api',rec.source+'\n;return (typeof plugin !== "undefined" ? plugin : (typeof STARLINE_PLUGIN !== "undefined" ? STARLINE_PLUGIN : null));'))(api);}
    catch(e){throw new Error(t('pluginExecError')+e.message);}
    if(!plugin||typeof plugin!=='object')throw new Error(t('pluginObjectError'));
    plugin.id=String(plugin.id||rec.id);plugin.name=String(plugin.name||rec.name||plugin.id);plugin.version=String(plugin.version||rec.version||'1.0.0');plugin.description=String(plugin.description||rec.description||'');
    return {plugin:plugin,api:api};
  }
  function activate(rec){if(!rec.enabled)return;try{var r=instantiate(rec);if(!r.api.requireApiVersion('>='+String(rec.minApiVersion||'2.0.0')))throw new Error('Incompatible API version. Requires '+String(rec.minApiVersion||'2.0.0')+', host provides 2.1.0.');runtime[rec.id]=r;if(typeof r.plugin.activate==='function')r.plugin.activate(r.api);}catch(e){rec.lastError=e.message;rec.enabled=false;write();toast(t('pluginEnableFailed')+' '+rec.name);}}
  function deactivate(rec){var r=runtime[rec.id];if(r){try{if(typeof r.plugin.deactivate==='function')r.plugin.deactivate(r.api);if(r.api&&typeof r.api.destroy==='function')r.api.destroy();}catch(e){}delete runtime[rec.id];}var nodes=pluginNodes[rec.id]||[];nodes.forEach(function(n){try{if(n&&n.remove)n.remove();}catch(e){}});delete pluginNodes[rec.id];removeHost(rec.id);updateStats();}
  function updateStats(){
    var n=0;Object.keys(hosts).forEach(function(k){if(hosts[k]&&hosts[k].widgets)n+=hosts[k].widgets.children.length;});panelCount=n;
    var en=installed.filter(function(x){return x.enabled;}).length;
    if($('pluginCount'))$('pluginCount').textContent=installed.length;
    if($('pluginEnabledCount'))$('pluginEnabledCount').textContent=en;
    if($('pluginWidgetCount'))$('pluginWidgetCount').textContent=panelCount;
    var b=$('sbPluginBadge');if(b){b.textContent=en;b.hidden=!en;}
  }
  /* ════════ 视图层：每个插件拥有独立的面板宿主；已启用插件显示在 Profile ▸ 插件 标签下 ════════ */
  var hosts={},sideOpen=true,resMode='';
  try{sideOpen=localStorage.getItem('starline.plugins.tabOpen')!=='0';}catch(e){}
  var ICON_PLUG='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 3v3M15 3v3M9 18v3M15 18v3M3 9h3M3 15h3M18 9h3M18 15h3"/><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M10 10h4v4h-4z"/></svg>';
  var ICON_EMPTY='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h6l2 2h8v12H4z"/><path d="M8 11h8M8 15h5"/></svg>';
  function hidePage(id){var e=$(id);if(e)e.hidden=true;}
  function enabledList(){return installed.filter(function(x){return x.enabled;});}
  function byId(id){for(var i=0;i<installed.length;i++){if(installed[i].id===id)return installed[i];}return null;}
  function viewActive(){var p=$('pluginViewPage');return !!(p&&!p.hidden);}
  function ensureHost(id){
    if(!id)return null;
    var h=hosts[id];if(h&&h.root&&h.root.parentNode)return h;
    var holder=$('pluginViewHost');if(!holder)return null;
    var root=document.createElement('div');root.className='plugin-host';root.setAttribute('data-plugin',id);root.hidden=true;
    var area=document.createElement('div');area.className='plugin-render-area';
    var widgets=document.createElement('div');widgets.className='plugin-widgets';
    root.appendChild(area);root.appendChild(widgets);holder.appendChild(root);
    h=hosts[id]={root:root,area:area,widgets:widgets,rendered:false};
    return h;
  }
  function removeHost(id){var h=hosts[id];if(h&&h.root&&h.root.parentNode)h.root.parentNode.removeChild(h.root);delete hosts[id];}

  /* 应用内对话框：api.confirmAsync / promptAsync 与卸载确认共用 */
  function dialogBox(kind,message,opts,defTitle){
    opts=opts||{};
    return new Promise(function(resolve){
      var old=$('starlinePluginDialog');if(old)old.remove();
      var overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='starlinePluginDialog';overlay.className='plugin-dialog-overlay';
      var box=document.createElement('section');box.className='plugin-card plugin-dialog';box.setAttribute('role','dialog');box.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
      var h=document.createElement('h3');h.textContent=String(opts.title||defTitle||'');
      var p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=String(message||'');
      box.appendChild(h);box.appendChild(p);
      var input=null;
      if(kind==='prompt'){input=document.createElement('input');input.className='ui-input';input.value=String(opts.defaultValue||'');input.placeholder=String(opts.placeholder||'');box.appendChild(input);}
      var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='plugin-dialog-row';
      var done=false;
      function finish(v){if(done)return;done=true;overlay.remove();resolve(v);}
      var cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.type='button';cancel.className='ui-btn';cancel.textContent=String(opts.cancelText||t('pluginDlgCancel'));
      cancel.onclick=function(){finish(kind==='prompt'?null:false);};
      var ok=document.createElement('button');ok.type='button';ok.className='ui-btn ui-btn-primary';ok.textContent=String(opts.okText||t('pluginDlgOk'));
      ok.onclick=function(){finish(kind==='prompt'?input.value:true);};
      row.appendChild(cancel);row.appendChild(ok);box.appendChild(row);overlay.appendChild(box);
      overlay.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===overlay)finish(kind==='prompt'?null:false);});
      overlay.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.stopPropagation();finish(kind==='prompt'?null:false);}else if(e.key==='Enter'&&input){finish(input.value);}});
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      if(input){input.focus();}else{ok.focus();}
    });
  }

  /* 侧栏：「我的插件」下面的「插件」标签，已启用的插件作为子项伸缩显示 */
  function renderSidebar(){
    var group=$('sbPluginGroup'),list=$('sbPluginList'),tab=$('navPluginTab');if(!group||!list)return;
    var en=enabledList(),open=en.length>0&&sideOpen,inView=viewActive();
    group.hidden=!en.length;
    group.classList.toggle('open',open);
    if(tab){tab.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');tab.title=t(open?'pluginTabCollapse':'pluginTabExpand');}
    list.innerHTML='';
    en.forEach(function(rec){
      var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='sb-sub-item'+(inView&&rec.id===selectedPluginId?' active':'');b.setAttribute('data-plugin',rec.id);
      b.title=rec.name+' · v'+(rec.version||'1.0.0');
      b.innerHTML='<span class="sb-sub-ico">'+ICON_PLUG+'</span><span class="sb-sub-name">'+esc(rec.name)+'</span>';
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){openPlugin(rec.id);});
      list.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  window.pluginTabToggle=function(){
    if(!enabledList().length)return;
    sideOpen=!sideOpen;try{localStorage.setItem('starline.plugins.tabOpen',sideOpen?'1':'0');}catch(e){}
    renderSidebar();
  };

  /* 右侧：整个插件面板 */
  function renderInto(rec,h){
    h.rendered=true;
    try{
      var r=runtime[rec.id]||instantiate(rec);runtime[rec.id]=r;
      if(typeof r.plugin.render==='function')r.plugin.render(h.area,r.api);
      else if(!h.widgets.children.length)h.area.innerHTML='<div class="plugin-empty">'+ICON_EMPTY+'<span>'+esc(t('pluginNoRender'))+'</span></div>';
    }catch(e){h.area.innerHTML='<div class="plugin-item-err">'+esc(t('pluginPanelError')+e.message)+'</div>';}
  }
  function refreshView(force){
    if(!$('pluginViewPage'))return;
    var rec=byId(selectedPluginId);
    if(!rec||!rec.enabled){var en=enabledList();rec=en[0]||null;selectedPluginId=rec?rec.id:'';}
    if(!rec){if(viewActive())window.showPlugins();return;}
    var h=ensureHost(rec.id);if(!h)return;
    Object.keys(hosts).forEach(function(k){if(hosts[k]&&hosts[k].root)hosts[k].root.hidden=(k!==rec.id);});
    h.root.hidden=false;
    if(!h.rendered||force){h.area.innerHTML='';renderInto(rec,h);}
    var title=$('pluginViewTitle'),meta=$('pluginViewMeta'),desc=$('pluginViewDesc');
    if(title)title.textContent=rec.name;
    if(meta)meta.innerHTML='<span>'+esc(rec.id)+'</span><span>v'+esc(rec.version||'1.0.0')+'</span><span class="plugin-item-state on"><i></i>'+esc(t('pluginOn'))+'</span>';
    if(desc)desc.textContent=rec.description||t('pluginNoDesc');
  }
  function openPlugin(id){
    var rec=byId(id);if(!rec)return;
    if(!rec.enabled){toast(t('pluginEnableFirst'));return;}
    if(typeof closeDetail==='function')closeDetail();
    selectedPluginId=id;
    ['storePage','profilePage','adminPage','pluginsPage','wheelPage'].forEach(hidePage);
    var vp=$('pluginViewPage');if(!vp)return;
    vp.hidden=false;try{vp.scrollTop=0;}catch(e){}
    document.querySelectorAll('.sb-item').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('active');});
    refreshView(false);renderSidebar();
  }
  window.pluginOpen=openPlugin;

  /* 我的插件：只负责管理（启用开关 / 打开面板 / 卸载），不再内嵌插件面板 */
  function uninstall(rec){
    dialogBox('confirm',fmt('pluginConfirmUninstall',{name:rec.name}),{title:t('pluginUninstall'),okText:t('pluginUninstall')},'').then(function(ok){
      if(!ok)return;
      try{deactivate(rec);}catch(e){}
      installed=installed.filter(function(x){return x.id!==rec.id;});
      if(selectedPluginId===rec.id)selectedPluginId='';
      write();render();toast(t('pluginUninstalled')+rec.name);
    });
  }
  function renderManage(){
    var list=$('pluginList');if(!list)return;
    list.innerHTML='';
    if(!installed.length){
      list.innerHTML='<div class="plugin-empty">'+ICON_EMPTY+'<strong>'+esc(t('pluginEmptyTitle'))+'</strong><span>'+esc(t('pluginEmptySub'))+'</span></div>';
      return;
    }
    installed.forEach(function(rec){
      var tip=esc(t(rec.enabled?'pluginToggleOff':'pluginToggleOn'));
      var card=document.createElement('article');card.className='plugin-item'+(rec.enabled?' on':'');card.setAttribute('data-plugin',rec.id);
      card.innerHTML=
        '<div class="plugin-item-head"><div class="plugin-icon">'+ICON_PLUG+'</div>'+
        '<div class="plugin-item-info"><div class="plugin-item-name">'+esc(rec.name)+'</div><div class="plugin-item-meta">'+esc(rec.id)+' · v'+esc(rec.version||'1.0.0')+'</div></div>'+
        '<label class="bg-switch" title="'+tip+'"><input type="checkbox" data-act="toggle" aria-label="'+tip+'"'+(rec.enabled?' checked':'')+'><span></span></label></div>'+
        '<div class="plugin-item-desc">'+esc(rec.description||t('pluginNoDesc'))+'</div>'+
        (rec.lastError?'<div class="plugin-item-err">'+esc(rec.lastError)+'</div>':'')+
        '<div class="plugin-item-foot"><span class="plugin-item-state'+(rec.enabled?' on':'')+'"><i></i>'+esc(t(rec.enabled?'pluginOn':'pluginOff'))+'</span><span class="spacer"></span>'+
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="open"'+(rec.enabled?'':' disabled')+'>'+esc(t('pluginView'))+'</button>'+
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost plugin-danger" data-act="remove">'+esc(t('pluginUninstall'))+'</button></div>';
      card.querySelector('[data-act="toggle"]').addEventListener('change',function(e){
        if(e.target.checked){
          rec.enabled=true;rec.lastError='';activate(rec);
          if(rec.enabled){sideOpen=true;try{localStorage.setItem('starline.plugins.tabOpen','1');}catch(err){}}
        }else{
          deactivate(rec);rec.enabled=false;
          if(selectedPluginId===rec.id)selectedPluginId='';
        }
        write();render();
      });
      card.querySelector('[data-act="open"]').addEventListener('click',function(){openPlugin(rec.id);});
      card.querySelector('[data-act="remove"]').addEventListener('click',function(){uninstall(rec);});
      list.appendChild(card);
    });
  }
  function render(force){
    renderManage();
    if(viewActive())refreshView(!!force);
    renderSidebar();
    updateStats();
  }

  /* 开发资源（API 文档 / 开发指南）：再次点击同一按钮即可收起 */
  function applyResource(){
    var docs=$('pluginApiDocs'),guide=$('pluginGuide');
    if(docs)docs.hidden=resMode!=='api';
    if(guide)guide.hidden=resMode!=='guide';
    var a=$('pluginApiDocsBtn'),g=$('pluginGuideBtn');
    if(a)a.classList.toggle('active',resMode==='api');
    if(g)g.classList.toggle('active',resMode==='guide');
    if(resMode==='api')renderApiDocs();
    var sec=resMode==='api'?docs:(resMode==='guide'?guide:null);
    if(sec&&sec.scrollIntoView){try{sec.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'});}catch(e){}}
  }
  function closeResource(){resMode='';applyResource();}
  window.pluginOpenResource=function(which){resMode=(resMode===which)?'':which;applyResource();};
  function importSource(name,source){
    if(!/\.js$/i.test(name)){toast(t('pluginJsOnly'));return;}
    var rec={id:'',name:name.replace(/\.js$/i,''),version:'1.0.0',description:'',source:source,enabled:false};
    try{
      var temp=instantiate(rec);var p=temp.plugin;
      rec.id=String(p.id||rec.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/g,'-')).slice(0,64);rec.name=String(p.name||rec.name).slice(0,80);rec.version=String(p.version||'1.0.0').slice(0,32);rec.description=String(p.description||'').slice(0,400);
      rec.permissions=Array.isArray(p.permissions)?p.permissions.map(String):[];rec.crossPlugin=Array.isArray(p.crossPlugin)?p.crossPlugin.map(String):[];rec.minApiVersion=String(p.minApiVersion||'2.0.0').slice(0,32);
      try{temp.api.destroy();}catch(e2){}
      if(!/^[a-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/i.test(rec.id))throw new Error(t('pluginBadId'));
    }catch(e){toast(e.message);return;}
    var old=byId(rec.id);
    function commit(){
      if(old){deactivate(old);installed=installed.filter(function(x){return x.id!==rec.id;});}
      installed.push(rec);write();render();
      toast(t('pluginImported')+rec.name,'ok',6000,{action:{label:t('pluginEnableNow'),run:function(){
        if(rec.enabled||!byId(rec.id))return;
        rec.enabled=true;rec.lastError='';activate(rec);
        if(rec.enabled){sideOpen=true;try{localStorage.setItem('starline.plugins.tabOpen','1');}catch(err){}}
        write();render();
      }}});
    }
    if(old){dialogBox('confirm',t('pluginExists'),{title:rec.name},'').then(function(ok){if(ok)commit();});}else{commit();}
  }
  function importFile(file){if(!file)return;var reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=function(){importSource(file.name,String(reader.result||''));};reader.onerror=function(){toast(t('pluginReadError'));};reader.readAsText(file,'utf-8');}
  window.showPlugins=function(){
    if(typeof closeDetail==='function')closeDetail();
    ['storePage','profilePage','adminPage','pluginViewPage','wheelPage'].forEach(hidePage);
    var pp=$('pluginsPage');if(pp)pp.hidden=false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.sb-item').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.id==='navPlugins');});
    render();
  };
  window.pluginShowGuide=function(show){if(show===false){closeResource();return;}resMode='guide';applyResource();};

  var overlay=$('fileDropOverlay'),depth=0,dropTarget='';
  function canImport(){return !!($('pluginsPage')&&!$('pluginsPage').hidden || $('profilePage')&&!$('profilePage').hidden || $('uiSettingsView')&&!$('uiSettingsView').hidden || $('ctView')&&!$('ctView').hidden);}
  function fileType(files){if(!files||!files.length)return '';var f=files[0];if(/\.json$/i.test(f.name))return 'json';if(/\.js$/i.test(f.name))return 'js';return '';}
  function showOverlay(type){if(!overlay)return;dropTarget=type;var isJs=type==='js';$('fileDropTitle').textContent=isJs?t('pluginDropTitle'):t('pluginDropJsonTitle');$('fileDropSub').textContent=isJs?t('pluginDropSub'):t('pluginDropJsonSub');overlay.classList.add('show');overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');}
  function hideOverlay(){depth=0;if(overlay){overlay.classList.remove('show');overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');}}
  window.addEventListener('dragenter',function(e){if(!canImport()||!e.dataTransfer||!Array.from(e.dataTransfer.types||[]).includes('Files'))return;depth++;var type=fileType(e.dataTransfer.files);showOverlay(type||($('pluginsPage')&&!$('pluginsPage').hidden?'js':'json'));});
  window.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){if(!canImport()||!e.dataTransfer||!Array.from(e.dataTransfer.types||[]).includes('Files'))return;e.preventDefault();if(e.dataTransfer)e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='copy';});
  window.addEventListener('dragleave',function(e){if(!canImport())return;depth=Math.max(0,depth-1);if(depth===0)hideOverlay();});
  window.addEventListener('drop',function(e){if(!e.dataTransfer||!e.dataTransfer.files||!e.dataTransfer.files.length)return;if(!canImport())return;e.preventDefault();var f=e.dataTransfer.files[0],type=fileType(e.dataTransfer.files);hideOverlay();
    if(type==='js'){if(!$('pluginsPage').hidden){importFile(f);}else{toast(t('pluginDropNeedPage'));}return;}
    if(type==='json'){var reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=function(){var ok=typeof window.uiImportTranslationFileText==='function'&&window.uiImportTranslationFileText(String(reader.result||''));if(!ok)toast(t('pluginJsonBad'));else toast(t('pluginJsonDone'));};reader.onerror=function(){toast(t('pluginJsonReadError'));};reader.readAsText(f,'utf-8');return;}
    toast(t('pluginDropUnsupported'));
  });
  window.addEventListener('dragend',hideOverlay);window.addEventListener('blur',hideOverlay);
})();

<script>
/* ═══════ 扩展：状态与订阅面板 / 订阅到期提醒 / 更新完成标记 / 更新日志搜索与 NEW / 键盘快捷键 ═══════ */
(function(){
  if(typeof UI_T==='undefined'||typeof GAMES==='undefined'||!document.getElementById('tbInbox'))return;
  var EN={
    stBtn:'Status & subscriptions (S)',stTitle:'Status',stAllOk:'All systems operational',stUpdN:'{n} updating',stOutN:'{n} outdated',
